entry.title: QIME: Constructing Interpretable Medical Text Embeddings via Ontology-Grounded Questions

author.name: Yixuan Tang, Zhenghong Lin, Yandong Sun, Anthony K. H. Tung

entry.summary: QIME constructs interpretable medical text embeddings where each dimension corresponds to a clinically meaningful yes/no question, grounded in medical ontologies.

entry.title: Phase-Type Variational Autoencoders for Heavy-Tailed Data

author.name: Abdelhakim Ziani, Andr\'as Horv\'ath, Paolo Ballarini

entry.summary: Proposes PH-VAE, a Variational Autoencoder using Phase-Type distributions as decoder, defined via continuous-time Markov chain absorption times, enabling flexible heavy-tailed data modeling.

entry.title: Explanation-Guided Adversarial Training for Robust and Interpretable Models

author.name: Chao Chen, Yanhui Chen, Shanshan Lin, Dongsheng Hong, Shu Wu, Xiangwen Liao, Chuanyi Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Explanation-Guided Adversarial Training (EGAT), unifying adversarial training with explanation-guided learning to improve both robustness and interpretability of deep neural networks simultaneously.

entry.title: Revealing Combinatorial Reasoning of GNNs via Graph Concept Bottleneck Layer

author.name: Yue Niu, Zhaokai Sun, Jiayi Yang, Xiaofeng Cao, Rui Fan, Xin Sun, Hanli Wang, Wei Ye

entry.summary: Develops a Graph Concept Bottleneck Layer for GNNs that reveals combinatorial reasoning through interpretable graph concepts, quantifying concept contributions to predictions rather than just identifying hard logical rules.

entry.title: GenDB: The Next Generation of Query Processing -- Synthesized, Not Engineered

author.name: Jiale Lao, Immanuel Trummer

entry.summary: Proposes GenDB, which uses LLMs to synthesize execution code for each incoming database query instead of using traditional query processing engines, arguing this represents the next generation of query processing.

entry.title: Kiwi-Edit: Versatile Video Editing via Instruction and Reference Guidance

author.name: Yiqi Lin, Guoqiang Liang, Ziyun Zeng, Zechen Bai, Yanzhe Chen, Mike Zheng Shou

entry.summary: Introduces Kiwi-Edit for video editing that combines instruction and reference guidance, with a scalable data generation pipeline that creates training quadruplets from existing pairs, and a new benchmark RefVIE-Bench.

entry.title: Physics-Aware Learnability: From Set-Theoretic Independence to Operational Constraints

author.name: Jeongho Bang, Kyoungho Cho

entry.summary: Introduces physics-aware learnability (PL) that resolves paradoxes in learning theory (like EMX learnability depending on ZFC axioms) by conditioning on explicit physical access models with finite precision constraints.

entry.title: Unlearning Evaluation through Subset Statistical Independence

author.name: Chenhao Zhang, Muxing Li, Feng Liu, Weitong Chen, Miao Xu

entry.summary: Proposes a subset-level evaluation framework for machine unlearning based on statistical independence using the Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion, without requiring model retraining or auxiliary classifiers.

entry.title: Adapt Data to Model: Adaptive Transformation Optimization for Domain-shared Time Series Foundation Models

author.name: Yunzhong Qiu, Zhiyao Cen, Zhongyi Pei, Chen Wang, Jianmin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes TATO, a data-centric framework that adapts a frozen pre-trained time series model to diverse domains through optimized transformation pipelines (context slicing, normalization, outlier correction) rather than model fine-tuning.

entry.title: Frozen Policy Iteration: Computationally Efficient RL under Linear $Q^{\pi}$ Realizability for Deterministic Dynamics

author.name: Yijing Ke, Zihan Zhang, Ruosong Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Frozen Policy Iteration, a computationally efficient online RL algorithm under linear Q^π realizability for MDPs with deterministic transitions, achieving regret bound of Õ(√(d²H⁶T)).

entry.title: Lookahead identification in adversarial bandits: accuracy and memory bounds

author.name: Nataly Brukhim, Nicol\`o Cesa-Bianchi, Carlo Ciliberto

entry.summary: Studies lookahead identification in adversarial bandits where the learner must select a future prediction window and commit to an arm whose average reward is near-optimal, characterizing achievable accuracy and memory requirements.

entry.title: Evaluating AI Grading on Real-World Handwritten College Mathematics: A Large-Scale Study Toward a Benchmark

author.name: Zhiqi Yu, Xingping Liu, Haobin Mao, Mingshuo Liu, Long Chen, Jack Xin, Yifeng Yu

entry.summary: Presents a large-scale study of AI grading for handwritten calculus work at UC Irvine, using OCR-conditioned LLMs with rubric-guided prompting to grade thousands of submissions from ~800 students with strong alignment to TA grades.

entry.title: Relatively Smart: A New Approach for Instance-Optimal Learning

author.name: Shaddin Dughmi, Alireza F. Pour

entry.summary: Proposes 'relatively smart' PAC learning that competes with semi-supervised learners only on distinguishable marginal distributions, overcoming impossibility results from prior work on instance-optimal learning.

entry.title: Transform-Invariant Generative Ray Path Sampling for Efficient Radio Propagation Modeling

author.name: J\'erome Eertmans, Enrico M. Vitucci, Vittorio Degli-Esposti, Nicola Di Cicco, Laurent Jacques, Claude Oestges

entry.summary: Proposes using Generative Flow Networks to replace exhaustive path searching in ray tracing for radio propagation modeling, addressing the exponential computational complexity of traditional methods.

entry.title: Safe Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning for Privacy-Aware Edge-Device Collaborative DNN Inference

author.name: Hong Wang, Xuwei Fan, Zhipeng Cheng, Yachao Yuan, Minghui Min, Minghui Liwang, Xiaoyu Xia

entry.summary: Proposes a privacy-aware collaborative DNN inference framework using hierarchical constrained multi-agent PPO for jointly optimizing inference delay, energy, and privacy across edge devices and servers.

entry.title: A Monte Carlo estimator of flow fields for sampling and noise problems

author.name: Michael S. Albergo, Gurtej Kanwar

entry.summary: Proposes a Monte Carlo estimator for flow fields in lattice field theory using coupled Langevin noise to mitigate statistical noise, demonstrated on U(1) transport and SU(N) glueball problems.

entry.title: Efficient Conformal Volumetry for Template-Based Segmentation

author.name: Matt Y. Cheung, Ashok Veeraraghavan, Guha Balakrishnan

entry.summary: ConVOLT applies conformal prediction to template-based medical image segmentation, providing finite-sample valid volumetric uncertainty intervals by conditioning on registration-derived features rather than treating registration as a black box.

entry.title: Time-Aware Latent Space Bayesian Optimization

author.name: Tuan A. Vu, Julien Martinelli, Harri L\"ahdesm\"aki

entry.summary: TALBO introduces time-awareness into latent-space Bayesian optimization for molecular design with temporal drift, incorporating time into both the surrogate model and learned generative representation via a GP-prior VAE.

entry.title: AgilePruner: An Empirical Study of Attention and Diversity for Adaptive Visual Token Pruning in Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Changwoo Baek, Jouwon Song, Sohyeon Kim, Kyeongbo Kong

entry.summary: AgilePruner conducts empirical analysis of attention-based vs. diversity-based visual token pruning in large vision-language models using effective rank and attention entropy, proposing an adaptive hybrid approach.

entry.title: VoxKnesset: A Large-Scale Longitudinal Hebrew Speech Dataset for Aging Speaker Modeling

author.name: Yanir Marmor, Arad Zulti, David Krongauz, Adam Gabet, Yoad Snapir, Yair Lifshitz, Eran Segal

entry.summary: VoxKnesset is a large-scale longitudinal Hebrew speech dataset (~2,300 hours, 15 years) from parliamentary recordings with verified metadata. Benchmarks show speaker verification degrades significantly over time.

entry.title: Co-optimization for Adaptive Conformal Prediction

author.name: Xiaoyi Su, Zhixin Zhou, Rui Luo

entry.summary: CoCP proposes co-optimization of prediction interval center and radius for adaptive conformal prediction, addressing inefficiency under heteroscedasticity and skewness compared to standard approaches like CQR.

entry.title: LOCUS: A Distribution-Free Loss-Quantile Score for Risk-Aware Predictions

author.name: Matheus Barreto, M\'ario de Castro, Thiago R. Ramos, Denis Valle, Rafael Izbicki

entry.summary: LOCUS provides a distribution-free per-input loss-scale reliability score for any prediction function, using split calibration for interpretable flagging with finite-sample coverage guarantees.

entry.title: LLM-Bootstrapped Targeted Finding Guidance for Factual MLLM-based Medical Report Generation

author.name: Cunyuan Yang, Dejuan Song, Xiaotao Pang, Qianqian Shen, Wenjie Nie, Yifan Huang, Lei Wu, Wei Han, Haishuai Wang, Jiajun Bu

entry.summary: Introduces Fact-Flow, a framework that separates visual fact identification from report generation in medical MLLMs, first predicting clinical findings from images then using those to guide report generation, reducing hallucination.

entry.title: From Literature to Hypotheses: An AI Co-Scientist System for Biomarker-Guided Drug Combination Hypothesis Generation

author.name: Raneen Younis, Suvinava Basak, Lukas Chavez, Zahra Ahmadi

entry.summary: Presents CoDHy, an AI co-scientist system for biomarker-guided drug combination hypothesis generation in cancer research, integrating structured databases with literature evidence into knowledge graphs for agent-based reasoning.

entry.title: RAVEL: Reasoning Agents for Validating and Evaluating LLM Text Synthesis

author.name: Andrew Zhuoer Feng, Cunxiang Wang, Yu Luo, Bosi Wen, Yidong Wang, Lin Fan, Yilin Zhou, Zikang Wang, Wenbo Yu, Lindong Wu, Hongning Wang, Minlie Huang

entry.summary: Introduces RAVEL, an agentic framework for evaluating LLM text synthesis capabilities through operations like outlining, drafting, reviewing, and refining, along with C3EBench benchmark of 1,258 samples from professional writing.

entry.title: Generative AI & Fictionality: How Novels Power Large Language Models

author.name: Edwin Roland, Richard Jean So

entry.summary: Analyzes how fiction in training data shapes LLM outputs compared to other text forms like newspapers and Reddit, examining 80 years of literary theory about narrative discourse properties.

entry.title: Suffix-Constrained Greedy Search Algorithms for Causal Language Models

author.name: Ayoub Hammal, Pierre Zweigenbaum, Caio Corro

entry.summary: Introduces suffix-constrained generation algorithms based on greedy search that guarantee LLM responses follow strict templates for trivially parseable final answers, solving the extraction problem for reasoning tasks.

entry.title: Quantifying Conversational Reliability of Large Language Models under Multi-Turn Interaction

author.name: Jiyoon Myung

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates LLM conversational reliability across multi-turn interactions, testing constraint maintenance, tool selection, and entity tracking under extended dialogues.

entry.title: Markovian ODE-guided scoring can assess the quality of offline reasoning traces in language models

author.name: Arghodeep Nandi, Ojasva Saxena, Tanmoy Chakraborty

entry.summary: Introduces MarODE, an offline evaluation framework for reasoning traces using Markovian ODE formulation, scoring quality based on human-centric perturbations and judgments.

entry.title: Beyond the Grid: Layout-Informed Multi-Vector Retrieval with Parsed Visual Document Representations

author.name: Yibo Yan, Mingdong Ou, Yi Cao, Xin Zou, Shuliang Liu, Jiahao Huo, Yu Huang, James Kwok, Xuming Hu

entry.summary: Introduces ColParse, a document retrieval paradigm using document parsing models to generate layout-informed sub-image embeddings fused with global page vectors, creating compact multi-vector representations for visual document retrieval.

entry.title: Latent Replay Detection: Memory-Efficient Continual Object Detection on Microcontrollers via Task-Adaptive Compression

author.name: Bibin Wilson

entry.summary: Presents LRD, the first framework for continual object detection on microcontrollers with severe memory constraints, using task-adaptive compression with FiLM conditioning and spatial-diverse exemplar selection.

entry.title: PointAlign: Feature-Level Alignment Regularization for 3D Vision-Language Models

author.name: Yuanhao Su, Shaofeng Zhang, Xiaosong Jia, Qi Fan

entry.summary: Proposes PointAlign, a feature-level alignment regularization for 3D Vision-Language Models that supervises intermediate point cloud tokens to preserve geometric-semantic information during language modeling.

entry.title: ReMoT: Reinforcement Learning with Motion Contrast Triplets

author.name: Cong Wan, Zeyu Guo, Jiangyang Li, SongLin Dong, Yifan Bai, Lin Peng, Zhiheng Ma, Yihong Gong

entry.summary: Proposes ReMoT, a training paradigm for improving spatio-temporal consistency in VLMs using motion-contrast triplets and Group Relative Policy Optimization, with a 16.5K triplet dataset.

entry.title: M$^2$: Dual-Memory Augmentation for Long-Horizon Web Agents via Trajectory Summarization and Insight Retrieval

author.name: Dawei Yan, Haokui Zhang, Guangda Huzhang, Yang Li, Yibo Wang, Qing-Guo Chen, Zhao Xu, Weihua Luo, Ying Li, Wei Dong, Chunhua Shen

entry.summary: Proposes M², a training-free dual-memory framework for long-horizon web agents that combines dynamic trajectory summarization with cross-task insight retrieval to improve context efficiency.

entry.title: Jano: Adaptive Diffusion Generation with Early-stage Convergence Awareness

author.name: Yuyang Chen, Linqian Zeng, Yijin ZHou, Hengjie Li, Jidong Zhai

entry.summary: Presents Jano, a training-free framework for efficient diffusion generation that identifies heterogeneous convergence patterns across image regions early in denoising, enabling adaptive compute allocation.

entry.title: Act Like a Pathologist: Tissue-Aware Whole Slide Image Reasoning

author.name: Wentao Huang, Weimin Lyu, Peiliang Lou, Qingqiao Hu, Xiaoling Hu, Shahira Abousamra, Wenchao Han, Ruifeng Guo, Jiawei Zhou, Chao Chen, Chen Wang

entry.summary: Proposes tissue-aware WSI reasoning that mimics pathologist workflow of scanning broadly and zooming selectively based on clinical questions, rather than uniform patch sampling.

entry.title: Specializing Foundation Models via Mixture of Low-Rank Experts for Comprehensive Head CT Analysis

author.name: Youngjin Yoo, Han Liu, Bogdan Georgescu, Yanbo Zhang, Sasa Grbic, Michael Baumgartner, Thomas J. Re, Jyotipriya Das, Poikavila Ullaskrishnan, Eva Eibenberger, Andrei Chekkoury, Uttam K. Bodanapally, Savvas Nicolaou, Pina C. Sanelli, Thomas J. Schroeppel, Yvonne W. Lui, Eli Gibson

entry.summary: Proposes MoLRE, a Mixture of Low-Rank Experts framework extending LoRA with multiple specialized adapters and unsupervised soft routing for comprehensive head CT analysis, using <0.5% additional parameters.

entry.title: Neural Functional Alignment Space: Brain-Referenced Representation of Artificial Neural Networks

author.name: Ruiyu Yan, Hanqi Jiang, Yi Pan, Xiaobo Li, Tianming Liu, Xi Jiang, Lin Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes NFAS, a brain-referenced framework for characterizing ANNs using Dynamic Mode Decomposition of layer-wise representations projected into biologically-anchored coordinates.

entry.title: \textsc{Mobile-VTON}: High-Fidelity On-Device Virtual Try-On

author.name: Zhenchen Wan, Ce Chen, Runqi Lin, Jiaxin Huang, Tianxi Chen, Yanwu Xu, Tongliang Liu, Mingming Gong

entry.summary: Mobile-VTON enables fully offline virtual try-on on mobile devices using a modular TeacherNet-GarmentNet-TryonNet architecture with knowledge distillation. Achieves high-fidelity results while preserving user privacy.

entry.title: PreciseCache: Precise Feature Caching for Efficient and High-fidelity Video Generation

author.name: Jiangshan Wang, Kang Zhao, Jiayi Guo, Jiayu Wang, Hang Guo, Chenyang Zhu, Xiu Li, Xiangyu Yue

entry.summary: PreciseCache is a plug-and-play framework that precisely identifies and skips truly redundant computations in video generation models, addressing quality degradation issues in prior feature caching methods.

entry.title: Foundation Models in Remote Sensing: Evolving from Unimodality to Multimodality

author.name: Danfeng Hong, Chenyu Li, Xuyang Li, Gustau Camps-Valls, Jocelyn Chanussot

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey on foundation models in remote sensing, tracking the evolution from unimodal to multimodal approaches. Covers model architectures, training paradigms, and applications across RS domains.

entry.title: Beyond Global Similarity: Towards Fine-Grained, Multi-Condition Multimodal Retrieval

author.name: Xuan Lu, Kangle Li, Haohang Huang, Rui Meng, Wenjun Zeng, Xiaoyu Shen

entry.summary: MCMR introduces a large-scale benchmark for fine-grained, multi-condition cross-modal retrieval spanning five product domains, addressing the gap where existing benchmarks focus on single-condition alignment.

entry.title: Perspective-Equivariant Fine-tuning for Multispectral Demosaicing without Ground Truth

author.name: Andrew Wang, Mike Davies

entry.summary: PEFD leverages projective geometry equivariance for multispectral demosaicing without ground truth, adapting pretrained foundation models using only mosaiced measurements.

entry.title: UETrack: A Unified and Efficient Framework for Single Object Tracking

author.name: Ben Kang, Jie Zhao, Xin Chen, Wanting Geng, Bin Zhang, Lu Zhang, Dong Wang, Huchuan Lu

entry.summary: UETrack proposes a unified efficient framework for single object tracking across multiple modalities (RGB, Depth, Thermal, Event, Language), using Token-Pooling MoE for resource-constrained deployment.

entry.title: Sparse View Distractor-Free Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Yi Gu, Zhaorui Wang, Jiahang Cao, Jiaxu Wang, Mingle Zhao, Dongjun Ye, Renjing Xu

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for distractor-free 3D Gaussian Splatting under sparse-view conditions by incorporating geometry foundation model priors (VGGT) for camera estimation and point generation.

entry.title: PromptStereo: Zero-Shot Stereo Matching via Structure and Motion Prompts

author.name: Xianqi Wang, Hao Yang, Hangtian Wang, Junda Cheng, Gangwei Xu, Min Lin, Xin Yang

entry.summary: PromptStereo introduces a Prompt Recurrent Unit for zero-shot stereo matching that leverages monocular depth foundation model decoders for iterative refinement with structure and motion prompts.

entry.title: GroupEnsemble: Efficient Uncertainty Estimation for DETR-based Object Detection

author.name: Yutong Yang, Katarina Popovi\'c, Julian Wiederer, Markus Braun, Vasileios Belagiannis, Bin Yang

entry.summary: GroupEnsemble provides efficient uncertainty estimation for DETR-based object detection by sharing most parameters across ensemble members, capturing both semantic and spatial uncertainty.

entry.title: Solving a Nonlinear Blind Inverse Problem for Tagged MRI with Physics and Deep Generative Priors

author.name: Zhangxing Bian, Shuwen Wei, Samuel W. Remedios, Junyu Chen, Aaron Carass, Blake E. Dewey, Jerry L. Prince

entry.summary: Introduces a blind nonlinear inverse framework for tagged MRI that unifies anatomical image recovery, high-resolution cine synthesis, and motion estimation using physics and deep generative priors.

entry.title: I-Perceive: A Foundation Model for Active Perception with Language Instructions

author.name: Yongxi Huang, Zhuohang Wang, Wenjing Tang, Cewu Lu, Panpan Cai

entry.summary: Introduces I-Perceive, a foundation model for active perception conditioned on natural language instructions for mobile manipulators. Predicts camera views following open-ended intents in indoor environments at scale.

entry.title: TraceSIR: A Multi-Agent Framework for Structured Analysis and Reporting of Agentic Execution Traces

author.name: Shu-Xun Yang, Cunxiang Wang, Haoke Zhang, Wenbo Yu, Lindong Wu, Jiayi Gui, Dayong Yang, Yukuo Cen, Zhuoer Feng, Bosi Wen, Yidong Wang, Lucen Zhong, Jiamin Ren, Linfeng Zhang, Jie Tang

entry.summary: Proposes TraceSIR, a multi-agent framework for structured analysis and reporting of agentic execution traces, coordinating three specialized agents for failure diagnosis and root cause analysis.

entry.title: Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts with Retrieval Augmentation for Protein Active Site Identification

author.name: Jiayang Wu, Jiale Zhou, Xingyi Zhang, Xun Lin, Tianxu Lv, Leong Hou U, Rubo Wang, Yefeng Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces MERA, the first retrieval-augmented framework for protein active site identification using multimodal mixture-of-experts with hierarchical retrieval from chain, sequence, and active-site perspectives.

entry.title: LiveCultureBench: a Multi-Agent, Multi-Cultural Benchmark for Large Language Models in Dynamic Social Simulations

author.name: Viet-Thanh Pham, Lizhen Qu, Thuy-Trang Vu, Gholamreza Haffari, Dinh Phung

entry.summary: Introduces LiveCultureBench, a multi-cultural benchmark that embeds LLMs as agents in a simulated town environment and evaluates them on both task completion and adherence to socio-cultural norms across diverse cultural contexts.

entry.title: Stochastic Parrots or Singing in Harmony? Testing Five Leading LLMs for their Ability to Replicate a Human Survey with Synthetic Data

author.name: Jason Miklian, Kristian Hoelscher, John E. Katsos

entry.summary: Tests five leading LLMs' ability to generate synthetic survey data replicating responses from 420 Silicon Valley developers. Finds technically plausible results but significant deviations in cultural and organizational complexity dimensions.

entry.title: PEPA: a Persistently Autonomous Embodied Agent with Personalities

author.name: Kaige Liu, Yang Li, Lijun Zhu, Weinan Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes PEPA, a persistently autonomous embodied agent that uses personality traits as an intrinsic organizational principle for generating goals and sustaining behavioral evolution without external supervision.

entry.title: Latent attention on masked patches for flow reconstruction

author.name: Ben Eze, Luca Magri, Andrea N\'ovoa

entry.summary: LAMP is a modified vision transformer for masked flow reconstruction in fluid dynamics that uses patch-wise POD for dimensionality reduction and single-layer transformer trained via closed-form regression.

entry.title: Stochastic Multi-Armed Bandits with Limited Control Variates

author.name: Arun Verma, Manjesh Kumar Hanawal, Arun Rajkumar

entry.summary: Studies multi-armed bandits with limited access to control variates (auxiliary information not available every round), proposing UCB-LCV that effectively combines reward and control variate estimators.

entry.title: The Texture-Shape Dilemma: Boundary-Safe Synthetic Generation for 3D Medical Transformers

author.name: Jiaqi Tang, Weixuan Xu, Shu Zhang, Fandong Zhang, Qingchao Chen

entry.summary: Identifies 'boundary aliasing' - a critical optimization conflict when adding synthetic textures to formula-driven supervised learning for medical segmentation. Proposes boundary-safe generation to address the texture-shape dilemma.

entry.title: MLRecon: Robust Markerless Freehand 3D Ultrasound Reconstruction via Coarse-to-Fine Pose Estimation

author.name: Yi Zhang, Puxun Tu, Kun Wang, Yulin Yan, Tao Ying, Xiaojun Chen

entry.summary: MLRecon achieves markerless freehand 3D ultrasound reconstruction using a single RGB-D camera and vision foundation models for drift-resilient 6D probe tracking, avoiding costly marker-based or sensor-based approaches.

entry.title: GuiDINO: Rethinking Vision Foundation Model in Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Zhuonan Liang, Wei Guo, Jie Gan, Yaxuan Song, Runnan Chen, Hang Chang, Weidong Cai

entry.summary: GuiDINO repositions DINOv3 as a visual guidance generator rather than a feature extractor for medical segmentation, using a lightweight TokenBook mechanism to create spatial guide masks that gate downstream segmentation features.

entry.title: Cross-Modal Guidance for Fast Diffusion-Based Computed Tomography

author.name: Timofey Efimov, Singanallur Venkatakrishnan, Maliha Hossain, Haley Duba-Sullivan, Amirkoushyar Ziabari

entry.summary: Proposes cross-modal guidance for diffusion-based CT reconstruction that leverages a complementary imaging modality without retraining the diffusion prior, enabling accelerated imaging of costly modalities like neutron CT.

entry.title: SeaVIS: Sound-Enhanced Association for Online Audio-Visual Instance Segmentation

author.name: Yingjian Zhu, Ying Wang, Yuyang Hong, Ruohao Guo, Kun Ding, Xin Gu, Bin Fan, Shiming Xiang

entry.summary: SeaVIS introduces the first online framework for audio-visual instance segmentation, using Causal Cross Attention Fusion for real-time processing of continuous video streams with audio history.

entry.title: TopoMaskV3: 3D Mask Head with Dense Offset and Height Predictions for Road Topology Understanding

author.name: Muhammet Esat Kalfaoglu, Halil Ibrahim Ozturk, Ozsel Kilinc, Alptekin Temizel

entry.summary: TopoMaskV3 advances mask-based road topology understanding to 3D with novel dense offset and height prediction heads, and is the first to address geographic data leakage in road topology evaluation.

entry.title: CoopDiff: A Diffusion-Guided Approach for Cooperation under Corruptions

author.name: Gong Chen, Chaokun Zhang, Pengcheng Lv

entry.summary: CoopDiff introduces a diffusion-based cooperative perception framework that mitigates corruptions in multi-agent settings via a teacher-student paradigm with quality-aware fusion and denoising.

entry.title: Zero-shot Low-Field MRI Enhancement via Diffusion-Based Adaptive Contrast Transport

author.name: Muyu Liu, Chenhe Du, Xuanyu Tian, Qing Wu, Xiao Wang, Haonan Zhang, Hongjiang Wei, Yuyao Zhang

entry.summary: DACT proposes a zero-shot framework for enhancing low-field MRI to high-field quality using diffusion-based adaptive contrast transport without paired training data.

entry.title: Bridging the gap between Performance and Interpretability: An Explainable Disentangled Multimodal Framework for Cancer Survival Prediction

author.name: Aniek Eijpe, Soufyan Lakbir, Melis Erdal Cesur, Sara P. Oliveira, Angelos Chatzimparmpas, Sanne Abeln, Wilson Silva

entry.summary: DIMAFx provides an explainable multimodal framework for cancer survival prediction with disentangled, interpretable modality-specific and shared representations from WSI and transcriptomics data.

entry.title: TENG-BC: Unified Time-Evolving Natural Gradient for Neural PDE Solvers with General Boundary Conditions

author.name: Hongjie Jiang, Di Luo

entry.summary: Introduces TENG-BC, a neural PDE solver using time-evolving natural gradient that handles general boundary conditions (Dirichlet, Neumann, Robin, mixed) within a unified framework with stable time evolution.

entry.title: Semantic Similarity is a Spurious Measure of Comic Understanding: Lessons Learned from Hallucinations in a Benchmarking Experiment

author.name: Christopher Driggers-Ellis, Nachiketh Tibrewal, Rohit Bogulla, Harsh Khanna, Sangpil Youm, Christan Grant, Bonnie Dorr

entry.summary: Benchmarks VLM performance on comic page-level interpretation tasks, identifies and categorizes hallucinations, and argues that semantic similarity is a spurious measure of comic understanding.

entry.title: RaUF: Learning the Spatial Uncertainty Field of Radar

author.name: Shengpeng Wang, Kuangyu Wang, Wei Wang

entry.summary: RaUF proposes a spatial uncertainty field framework for radar that models measurements through physically-grounded anisotropic properties, resolving conflicting feature-to-label mappings in radar perception.

entry.title: Flow Matching-enabled Test-Time Refinement for Unsupervised Cardiac MR Registration

author.name: Yunguan Fu, Wenjia Bai, Wen Yan, Matthew J Clarkson, Rhodri Huw Davies, Yipeng Hu

entry.summary: FlowReg applies flow matching to cardiac MR registration, achieving strong registration in as few as two steps. Uses warmup-reflow training that eliminates the need for pre-trained models.

entry.title: TIMI: Training-Free Image-to-3D Multi-Instance Generation with Spatial Fidelity

author.name: Xiao Cai, Lianli Gao, Pengpeng Zeng, Ji Zhang, Heng Tao Shen, Jingkuan Song

entry.summary: TIMI proposes a training-free framework for image-to-3D multi-instance generation with spatial fidelity, using instance-aware separation guidance to disentangle instances from pre-trained I23D models.

entry.title: WhisperNet: A Scalable Solution for Bandwidth-Efficient Collaboration

author.name: Gong Chen, Chaokun Zhang, Xinyan Zhao

entry.summary: WhisperNet proposes a bandwidth-aware, receiver-centric collaborative perception framework where receivers formulate global request plans from sender saliency metadata, reducing communication overhead.

entry.title: Streaming Real-Time Trajectory Prediction Using Endpoint-Aware Modeling

author.name: Alexander Prutsch, David Schinagl, Horst Possegger

entry.summary: Proposes a streaming real-time trajectory prediction approach that integrates previous predictions with endpoint-aware modeling for continuous autonomous driving scenarios, achieving low latency.

entry.title: Stereo-Inertial Poser: Towards Metric-Accurate Shape-Aware Motion Capture Using Sparse IMUs and a Single Stereo Camera

author.name: Tutian Tang, Xingyu Ji, Yutong Li, MingHao Liu, Wenqiang Xu, Cewu Lu

entry.summary: Stereo-Inertial Poser combines a stereo camera with 6 IMUs for metric-accurate, shape-aware real-time motion capture, resolving monocular depth ambiguity.

entry.title: GeoDiT: Point-Conditioned Diffusion Transformer for Satellite Image Synthesis

author.name: Srikumar Sastry, Dan Cher, Brian Wei, Aayush Dhakal, Subash Khanal, Dev Gupta, Nathan Jacobs

entry.summary: GeoDiT introduces a diffusion transformer for text-to-satellite image generation with a novel point-based conditioning framework using spatial locations and text descriptions.

entry.title: MemeIntel: Explainable Detection of Propagandistic and Hateful Memes

author.name: Mohamed Bayan Kmainasi, Abul Hasnat, Md Arid Hasan, Ali Ezzat Shahroor, Firoj Alam

entry.summary: MemeIntel introduces MemeXplain, an explanation-enhanced dataset for propagandistic and hateful meme detection in Arabic and English, with a framework for joint label detection and rationale generation.

entry.title: FATE: Closed-Loop Feasibility-Aware Task Generation with Active Repair for Physically Grounded Robotic Curricula

author.name: Bingchuan Wei, Bingqi Huang, Jingheng Ma, Zeyu zhang, Sen Cui

entry.summary: Proposes FATE, a closed-loop task generation framework that embeds a generalist embodied agent into the generation loop to validate physical feasibility of LLM-generated robotic task curricula.

entry.title: Multi-Sourced, Multi-Agent Evidence Retrieval for Fact-Checking

author.name: Shuzhi Gong, Richard O. Sinnott, Jianzhong Qi, Cecile Paris, Preslav Nakov, Zhuohan Xie

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-agent RAG system for fact-checking that retrieves evidence from multiple sources while capturing multi-hop semantic relations. Addresses limitations of existing methods that rely on textual similarity alone.

entry.title: MicroVerse: A Preliminary Exploration Toward a Micro-World Simulation

author.name: Rongsheng Wang, Minghao Wu, Hongru Zhou, Zhihan Yu, Zhenyang Cai, Junying Chen, Benyou Wang

entry.summary: Introduces MicroWorldBench, a benchmark for evaluating video generation models on microscale simulation tasks (organ-level, cellular, subcellular), with 459 expert-annotated evaluation criteria.

entry.title: LiTS: A Modular Framework for LLM Tree Search

author.name: Xinzhe Li, Yaguang Tao

entry.summary: Presents LiTS, a modular Python framework for LLM reasoning via tree search, decomposing into reusable Policy, Transition, and RewardModel components. Reports a mode-collapse finding in infinite action spaces.

entry.title: FCN-LLM: Empower LLM for Brain Functional Connectivity Network Understanding via Graph-level Multi-task Instruction Tuning

author.name: Xingcan Hu, Wei Wang, Li Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes FCN-LLM, a framework enabling LLMs to understand brain functional connectivity networks from fMRI through graph-level multi-task instruction tuning with multi-scale encoding.

entry.title: Beyond Reward: A Bounded Measure of Agent Environment Coupling

author.name: Wael Hafez, Cameron Reid, Amit Nazeri

entry.summary: Introduces 'bipredictability' (P) as a bounded measure of agent-environment coupling based on information theory, with an Information Digital Twin monitor computing diagnostic components from interaction streams.

entry.title: Graph-Based Self-Healing Tool Routing for Cost-Efficient LLM Agents

author.name: Neeraj Bholani

entry.summary: Presents Self-Healing Router for LLM agents that treats control flow as routing rather than reasoning, using Dijkstra's algorithm on cost-weighted tool graphs with automatic rerouting when tools fail.

entry.title: GMP: A Benchmark for Content Moderation under Co-occurring Violations and Dynamic Rules

author.name: Houde Dong, Yifei She, Kai Ye, Liangcai Su, Chenxiong Qian, Jie Hao

entry.summary: Introduces GMP, a benchmark for content moderation addressing two underexplored challenges: co-occurring violations (a post violating multiple policies simultaneously) and dynamic platform-specific rules that evolve over time.

entry.title: StaTS: Spectral Trajectory Schedule Learning for Adaptive Time Series Forecasting with Frequency Guided Denoiser

author.name: Jintao Zhang, Zirui Liu, Mingyue Cheng, Xianquan Wang, Zhiding Liu, Qi Liu

entry.summary: Proposes StaTS, a diffusion model for probabilistic time series forecasting that jointly learns the noise schedule and denoiser through alternating updates with spectral regularization for better structural preservation.

entry.title: Physics-Consistent Diffusion for Efficient Fluid Super-Resolution via Multiscale Residual Correction

author.name: Zhihao Li, Shengwei Dong, Chuang Yi, Junxuan Gao, Zhilu Lai, Zhiqiang Liu, Wei Wang, Guangtao Zhang

entry.summary: ReMD proposes physics-consistent diffusion for fluid super-resolution using multigrid residual correction with multi-wavelet basis, addressing spectral mismatch and spurious divergence issues in existing image SR methods applied to fluids.

entry.title: SKeDA: A Generative Watermarking Framework for Text-to-video Diffusion Models

author.name: Yang Yang, Xinze Zou, Zehua Ma, Han Fang, Weiming Zhang

entry.summary: SKeDA proposes a generative watermarking framework for text-to-video diffusion models that addresses frame alignment issues when extending image watermarking to videos.

entry.title: Polynomial Surrogate Training for Differentiable Ternary Logic Gate Networks

author.name: Sai Sandeep Damera, Ryan Matheu, Aniruddh G. Puranic, John S. Baras

entry.summary: Extends differentiable logic gate networks to ternary Kleene K3 logic with UNKNOWN states via Polynomial Surrogate Training, achieving 2,187x parameter reduction per neuron while maintaining trainability.

entry.title: FastBUS: A Fast Bayesian Framework for Unified Weakly-Supervised Learning

author.name: Ziquan Wang, Haobo Wang, Ke Chen, Lei Feng, Gang Chen

entry.summary: FastBUS proposes a Bayesian framework for unified weakly-supervised learning that infers latent true label distributions across various weak supervision types, using a shared Bayesian network to compress diverse supervision structures.

entry.title: CMI-RewardBench: Evaluating Music Reward Models with Compositional Multimodal Instruction

author.name: Yinghao Ma, Haiwen Xia, Hewei Gao, Weixiong Chen, Yuxin Ye, Yuchen Yang, Sungkyun Chang, Mingshuo Ding, Yizhi Li, Ruibin Yuan, Simon Dixon, Emmanouil Benetos

entry.summary: CMI-RewardBench establishes a benchmark ecosystem for evaluating music reward models under compositional multimodal instructions (text, lyrics, audio prompts), including preference datasets and evaluation metrics.

entry.title: IDER: IDempotent Experience Replay for Reliable Continual Learning

author.name: Zhanwang Liu, Yuting Li, Haoyuan Gao, Yexin Li, Linghe Kong, Lichao Sun, Weiran Huang

entry.summary: IDER introduces idempotent experience replay for continual learning that provides uncertainty awareness with low computational overhead, leveraging the idempotent property where repeated applications yield consistent outputs.

entry.title: Prompt Sensitivity and Answer Consistency of Small Open-Source Large Language Models on Clinical Question Answering: Implications for Low-Resource Healthcare Deployment

author.name: Shravani Hariprasad

entry.summary: Evaluates five small open-source LLMs on clinical QA across prompt styles, finding consistency and accuracy are largely independent, and domain-pretrained models without instruction tuning have high failure rates.

entry.title: From Intuition to Investigation: A Tool-Augmented Reasoning MLLM Framework for Generalizable Face Anti-Spoofing

author.name: Haoyuan Zhang, Keyao Wang, Guosheng Zhang, Haixiao Yue, Zhiwen Tan, Siran Peng, Tianshuo Zhang, Xiao Tan, Kunbin Chen, Wei He, Jingdong Wang, Ajian Liu, Xiangyu Zhu, Zhen Lei

entry.summary: TAR-FAS introduces tool-augmented reasoning for face anti-spoofing, incorporating external visual tools into MLLMs via chain-of-thought with visual tool chaining to detect fine-grained spoof patterns.

entry.title: MedCollab: Causal-Driven Multi-Agent Collaboration for Full-Cycle Clinical Diagnosis via IBIS-Structured Argumentation

author.name: Yuqi Zhan, Xinyue Wu, Tianyu Lin, Yutong Bao, Xiaoyu Wang, Weihao Cheng, Huangwei Chen, Feiwei Qin, Zhu Zhu

entry.summary: MedCollab presents a multi-agent LLM framework emulating hierarchical hospital consultation workflows with dynamic specialist recruitment and IBIS-structured argumentation for clinical diagnosis.

entry.title: SphUnc: Hyperspherical Uncertainty Decomposition and Causal Identification via Information Geometry

author.name: Rong Fu, Chunlei Meng, Jinshuo Liu, Dianyu Zhao, Yongtai Liu, Yibo Meng, Xiaowen Ma, Wangyu Wu, Yangchen Zeng, Kangning Cui, Shuaishuai Cao, Simon Fong

entry.summary: SphUnc combines hyperspherical representation learning with structural causal modeling for uncertainty decomposition, using von Mises-Fisher distributions to separate epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty.

entry.title: GlassMol: Interpretable Molecular Property Prediction with Concept Bottleneck Models

author.name: Oscar Rivera, Ziqing Wang, Matthieu Dagommer, Abhishek Pandey, Kaize Ding

entry.summary: GlassMol adapts Concept Bottleneck Models to molecular property prediction, projecting molecular features through human-interpretable chemical concepts before making predictions.

entry.title: PhotoBench: Beyond Visual Matching Towards Personalized Intent-Driven Photo Retrieval

author.name: Tianyi Xu, Rong Shan, Junjie Wu, Jiadeng Huang, Teng Wang, Jiachen Zhu, Wenteng Chen, Minxin Tu, Quantao Dou, Zhaoxiang Wang, Changwang Zhang, Weinan Zhang, Jun Wang, Jianghao Lin

entry.summary: PhotoBench introduces the first benchmark for personalized intent-driven photo retrieval from authentic personal albums, shifting from visual matching to multi-source reasoning.

entry.title: FAST-DIPS: Adjoint-Free Analytic Steps and Hard-Constrained Likelihood Correction for Diffusion-Prior Inverse Problems

author.name: Minwoo Kim, Seunghyeok Shin, Hongki Lim

entry.summary: FAST-DIPS proposes a training-free diffusion prior solver for inverse problems using hard measurement-space feasibility constraints and analytic step sizes, replacing expensive inner optimization loops.

entry.title: DeLo: Dual Decomposed Low-Rank Experts Collaboration for Continual Missing Modality Learning

author.name: Xiwei Liu, Yulong Li, Feilong Tang, Imran Razzak

entry.summary: DeLo proposes dual-decomposed low-rank experts for continual missing modality learning, addressing cross-task and modality interference in adapting large multimodal models to sequential streams.

entry.title: MVR: Multi-view Video Reward Shaping for Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Lirui Luo, Guoxi Zhang, Hongming Xu, Yaodong Yang, Cong Fang, Qing Li

entry.summary: MVR proposes multi-view video reward shaping for RL using vision-language models, addressing single-viewpoint limitations and ensuring reward shaping doesn't alter optimal policy.

entry.title: Streaming Continual Learning for Unified Adaptive Intelligence in Dynamic Environments

author.name: Federico Giannini, Giacomo Ziffer, Andrea Cossu, Vincenzo Lomonaco

entry.summary: Proposes Streaming Continual Learning (SCL), a unified framework combining Continual Learning and Streaming Machine Learning to handle non-stationary data streams without forgetting. The paper bridges terminology and techniques between the two fields and defines key features of this combined setting.

entry.title: TiledAttention: a CUDA Tile SDPA Kernel for PyTorch

author.name: Taimur Khan

entry.summary: Introduces TiledAttention, a CUDA-based scaled dot-product attention kernel for PyTorch implemented in TileIR, designed for easier modification and kernel research while maintaining realistic performance.

entry.title: Mitigating topology biases in Graph Diffusion via Counterfactual Intervention

author.name: Wendi Wang, Jiaxi Yang, Yongkang Du, Lu Lin

entry.summary: Proposes FairGDiff, a counterfactual-based approach to mitigate topology biases from sensitive attributes in graph diffusion models, enabling fairer synthetic graph generation.

entry.title: Selection as Power: Constrained Reinforcement for Bounded Decision Authority

author.name: Jose Manuel de la Chica Rodriguez, Juan Manuel Vera D\'iaz

entry.summary: Proposes constrained reinforcement learning for bounded decision authority in agentic systems, extending the 'Selection as Power' framework to dynamic settings with governance constraints on parameter updates.

entry.title: BiJEPA: Bi-directional Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Symmetric Representation Learning

author.name: Yongchao Huang

entry.summary: Proposes BiJEPA, a bi-directional extension of JEPA (Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture) that enforces cycle-consistent predictability between data segments with norm regularization to prevent representation collapse. This addresses a limitation of standard uni-directional JEPA models by capturing informative signals in both prediction directions.

entry.title: Improving Full Waveform Inversion in Large Model Era

author.name: Yinan Feng, Peng Jin, Yuzhe Guo, Yinpeng Chen, Youzuo Lin

entry.summary: Demonstrates that a billion-parameter model trained on simulated seismic data can generalize to realistic geological benchmarks for Full Waveform Inversion, providing a recipe for scaling models in this domain.

entry.title: Analyzing Physical Adversarial Example Threats to Machine Learning in Election Systems

author.name: Khaleque Md Aashiq Kamal, Surya Eada, Aayushi Verma, Subek Acharya, Adrian Yemin, Benjamin Fuller, Kaleel Mahmood

entry.summary: Analyzes adversarial example attacks on ML-based ballot classifiers for US elections, deriving a probabilistic framework for the number of adversarial ballots needed to flip an election and testing physical-world attack effectiveness.

entry.title: Evaluating GFlowNet from partial episodes for stable and flexible policy-based training

author.name: Puhua Niu, Shili Wu, Xiaoning Qian

entry.summary: Shows that flow balance in GFlowNets yields principled policy divergence estimates from partial episodes, bridging value-based and policy-based training perspectives for more stable GFlowNet optimization.

entry.title: S2O: Enhancing Adversarial Training with Second-Order Statistics of Weights

author.name: Gaojie Jin, Xinping Yi, Wei Huang, Sven Schewe, Xiaowei Huang

entry.summary: Proposes S²O for adversarial training that treats model weights as random variables and optimizes second-order statistics, relaxing the common weight independence assumption in PAC-Bayesian frameworks.

entry.title: PAC Guarantees for Reinforcement Learning: Sample Complexity, Coverage, and Structure

author.name: Joshua Steier

entry.summary: Surveys PAC guarantees in RL from 2018-2025, proposing the Coverage-Structure-Objective (CSO) framework as an interpretive template for decomposing sample complexity results.

entry.title: Uncertainty Quantification of Click and Conversion Estimates for the Autobidding

author.name: Ivan Zhigalskii, Andrey Pudovikov, Aleksandr Katrutsa, Egor Samosvat

entry.summary: DenoiseBid proposes a Bayesian approach to correct uncertain CTR/CVR predictions for autobidding algorithms in e-commerce, replacing noisy point estimates with denoised predictions for more efficient auction participation.

entry.title: RSS map-assisted MIMO channel estimation in the upper mid-band under pilot constraints

author.name: Alireza Javid, Nuria Gonz\'alez-Prelcic

entry.summary: Presents a physics-informed neural network framework for wireless channel estimation that combines model-based estimation with deep networks using RSS map prior information.

entry.title: Aurchestra: Fine-Grained, Real-Time Soundscape Control on Resource-Constrained Hearables

author.name: Seunghyun Oh, Malek Itani, Aseem Gauri, Shyamnath Gollakota

entry.summary: Aurchestra enables fine-grained, real-time soundscape control on resource-constrained hearable devices, allowing users to independently adjust up to 5 overlapping sound sources. It combines a dynamic interface with an on-device multi-output extraction network.

entry.title: Stop Treating Collisions Equally: Qualification-Aware Semantic ID Learning for Recommendation at Industrial Scale

author.name: Zheng Hu, Yuxin Chen, Yongsen Pan, Xu Yuan, Yuting Yin, Daoyuan Wang, Boyang Xia, Zefei Luo, Hongyang Wang, Songhao Ni, Dongxu Liang, Jun Wang, Shimin Cai, Tao Zhou, Fuji Ren, Wenwu Ou

entry.summary: Addresses the collision problem in Semantic IDs for recommendation systems, where semantically distinct items get identical representations. Proposes Qualification-Aware learning that distinguishes harmful collisions from benign ones.

entry.title: BadRSSD: Backdoor Attacks on Regularized Self-Supervised Diffusion Models

author.name: Jiayao Wang, Yiping Zhang, Mohammad Maruf Hasan, Xiaoying Lei, Jiale Zhang, Junwu Zhu, Qilin Wu, Dongfang Zhao

entry.summary: BadRSSD is the first backdoor attack targeting the representation layer of self-supervised diffusion models, hijacking semantic representations in PCA space toward target images.

entry.title: Adaptive Estimation and Inference in Conditional Moment Models via the Discrepancy Principle

author.name: Jiyuan Tan, Vasilis Syrgkanis

entry.summary: Introduces a discrepancy-principle-based framework for adaptive hyperparameter selection in ill-posed inverse problems defined by conditional moment restrictions, removing the need for prior smoothness knowledge.

entry.title: PhysFormer: A Physics-Embedded Generative Model for Physically Self-Consistent Spectral Synthesis

author.name: Siqi Wang, Mengmeng Zhang, Yude Bu, Chaozhou Mou

entry.summary: PhysFormer is a generative framework that embeds physical self-consistency into a transformer using a physically interpretable latent space, avoiding external physics loss functions for spectral synthesis.

entry.title: Accurate, private, secure, federated U-statistics with higher degree

author.name: Quentin Sinh (MAGNET), Jan Ramon (MAGNET)

entry.summary: Proposes a protocol for computing U-statistics of degree k≥2 under central differential privacy using multi-party computation, substantially improving accuracy over local DP methods in federated settings.

entry.title: From Pixels to Patches: Pooling Strategies for Earth Embeddings

author.name: Isaac Corley, Caleb Robinson, Inbal Becker-Reshef, Juan M. Lavista Ferres

entry.summary: Introduces EuroSAT-Embed benchmark and evaluates 13 pooling strategies for aggregating pixel-level geospatial embeddings to patch-level, showing richer pooling reduces geographic generalization gap by up to 50%.

entry.title: Is Bigger Always Better? Efficiency Analysis in Resource-Constrained Small Object Detection

author.name: Kwame Mbobda-Kuate, Gabriel Kasmi

entry.summary: Systematic efficiency analysis of object detection scaling for rooftop PV detection in Madagascar, finding that the smallest YOLO model (11N) achieves both highest efficiency and highest absolute mAP, challenging scaling law assumptions.

entry.title: TAB-PO: Preference Optimization with a Token-Level Adaptive Barrier for Token-Critical Structured Generation

author.name: Samah Fodeh, Linhai Ma, Ganesh Puthiaraju, Srivani Talakokkul, Afshan Khan, Ashley Hagaman, Sarah R. Lowe, Aimee Kendall Roundtree

entry.summary: Proposes TAB-PO, a token-level adaptive barrier method for Direct Preference Optimization that addresses margin collapse in structured prediction tasks like medical annotation. It targets scenarios where chosen/rejected pairs differ by only 1-3 tokens and token importance is highly skewed.

entry.title: LaSTR: Language-Driven Time-Series Segment Retrieval

author.name: Kota Dohi, Harsh Purohit, Tomoya Nishida, Takashi Endo, Yusuke Ohtsubo, Koichiro Yawata, Koki Takeshita, Tatsuya Sasaki, Yohei Kawaguchi

entry.summary: Proposes LaSTR for language-driven time-series segment retrieval, training a contrastive retriever using segment captions generated by GPT-5.2 on LOTSA windows with TV2-based segmentation.

entry.title: DEP: A Decentralized Large Language Model Evaluation Protocol

author.name: Jianxiang Peng, Junhao Li, Hongxiang Wang, Haocheng Lyu, Hui Guo, Siyi Hao, Zhen Wang, Chuang Liu, Shaowei Zhang, Bojian Xiong, Yue Chen, Zhuowen Han, Ling Shi, Tianyu Dong, Juesi Xiao, Lei Yang, Yuqi Ren, Deyi Xiong

entry.summary: Proposes DEP, a decentralized evaluation protocol for LLMs that separates datasets/answers from evaluation infrastructure to prevent benchmark leakage while maintaining unified standards.

entry.title: Can Thinking Models Think to Detect Hateful Memes?

author.name: Mohamed Bayan Kmainasi, Mucahid Kutlu, Ali Ezzat Shahroor, Abul Hasnat, Firoj Alam

entry.summary: Proposes an RL-based post-training framework for improving hateful meme detection in thinking-based MLLMs using Group Relative Policy Optimization and extends existing datasets with pseudo-supervised data.

entry.title: Bootstrapping Embeddings for Low Resource Languages

author.name: Merve Basoz, Andrew Horne, Mattia Opper

entry.summary: Investigates generating synthetic training data for low-resource language embedding models using LLMs, testing in-context learning, adapter composition, and cross-lingual LoRA finetuning (XL-LoRA).

entry.title: ClinConsensus: A Consensus-Based Benchmark for Evaluating Chinese Medical LLMs across Difficulty Levels

author.name: Xiang Zheng, Han Li, Wenjie Luo, Weiqi Zhai, Yiyuan Li, Chuanmiao Yan, Tianyi Tang, Yubo Ma, Kexin Yang, Dayiheng Liu, Hu Wei, Bing Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces ClinConsensus, a Chinese medical benchmark with 2,500 expert-validated open-ended cases spanning 36 specialties and 12 clinical task types with progressive difficulty levels.

entry.title: Percept-Aware Surgical Planning for Visual Cortical Prostheses with Vascular Avoidance

author.name: Galen Pogoncheff, Alvin Wang, Jacob Granley, Michael Beyeler

entry.summary: Presents a percept-aware framework for surgical planning of cortical visual prostheses that optimizes electrode placement end-to-end using a differentiable forward model of cortical stimulation with vascular avoidance constraints.

entry.title: Wavelet-based Frame Selection by Detecting Semantic Boundary for Long Video Understanding

author.name: Wang Chen, Yuhui Zeng, Yongdong Luo, Tianyu Xie, Luojun Lin, Jiayi Ji, Yan Zhang, Xiawu Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces WFS-SB, a training-free wavelet-based frame selection method for long video understanding that detects semantic boundaries (narrative shifts) rather than just high-relevance frames.

entry.title: Linking Modality Isolation in Heterogeneous Collaborative Perception

author.name: Changxing Liu, Zichen Chao, Siheng Chen

entry.summary: Proposes CodeAlign, the first co-occurrence-free alignment framework for heterogeneous collaborative perception, addressing modality isolation where agents with different modalities never co-occur in training.

entry.title: Stateful Cross-layer Vision Modulation

author.name: Ying Liu, Yudong Han, Kean Shi, Liyuan Pan

entry.summary: Proposes stateful cross-layer vision modulation for MLLMs that intervenes during visual representation formation rather than after encoding, preventing suppression of fine-grained details from early layers.

entry.title: TokenSplat: Token-aligned 3D Gaussian Splatting for Feed-forward Pose-free Reconstruction

author.name: Yihui Li, Chengxin Lv, Zichen Tang, Hongyu Yang, Di Huang

entry.summary: Presents TokenSplat for joint 3D Gaussian reconstruction and camera pose estimation from unposed multi-view images, with token-aligned Gaussian prediction and asymmetric dual-flow decoder.

entry.title: Diversity over Uniformity: Rethinking Representation in Generated Image Detection

author.name: Qinghui He, Haifeng Zhang, Qiao Qin, Bo Liu, Xiuli Bi, Bin Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes an anti-feature-collapse learning framework for generated image detection that preserves multiple judgment perspectives rather than relying on single decision paths, improving generalization to unseen generators.

entry.title: StegoNGP: 3D Cryptographic Steganography using Instant-NGP

author.name: Wenxiang Jiang, Yujun Lan, Shuo Zhao, Yuanshan Liu, Mingzhu Zhou, Jinxin Wang

entry.summary: StegoNGP uses Instant-NGP's hash encoding as a key-controlled scene switcher for 3D steganography, embedding an entire hidden 3D scene within the same network weights as a cover scene without external decoders.

entry.title: Vision-Language Feature Alignment for Road Anomaly Segmentation

author.name: Zhuolin He, Jiacheng Tang, Jian Pu, Xiangyang Xue

entry.summary: VL-Anomaly uses vision-language model priors for road anomaly segmentation, incorporating prompt learning-driven alignment to reduce false positives on semantically normal backgrounds and improve OOD detection.

entry.title: Can Vision Language Models Assess Graphic Design Aesthetics? A Benchmark, Evaluation, and Dataset Perspective

author.name: Arctanx An, Shizhao Sun, Danqing Huang, Mingxi Cheng, Yan Gao, Ji Li, Yu Qiao, Jiang Bian

entry.summary: AesEval-Bench benchmarks VLMs on graphic design aesthetics assessment across four dimensions and twelve indicators. Reveals significant gaps between VLM and human aesthetic judgment, then provides training data for improvement.

entry.title: FREE-Edit: Using Editing-aware Injection in Rectified Flow Models for Zero-shot Image-Driven Video Editing

author.name: Maomao Li, Yunfei Liu, Yu Li

entry.summary: FREE-Edit proposes editing-aware injection for image-driven video editing using rectified flow models, modulating attention injection based on editing degree to balance source fidelity and edit propagation.

entry.title: FoSS: Modeling Long Range Dependencies and Multimodal Uncertainty in Trajectory Prediction via Fourier State Space Integration

author.name: Yizhou Huang, Gengze Jiang, Yihua Cheng, Kezhi Wang

entry.summary: FoSS combines frequency-domain reasoning via Fourier transforms with linear-time state space models for trajectory prediction, decomposing trajectories into amplitude (global intent) and phase (local variation) components.

entry.title: UltraStar: Semantic-Aware Star Graph Modeling for Echocardiography Navigation

author.name: Teng Wang, Haojun Jiang, Chenxi Li, Diwen Wang, Yihang Tang, Zhenguo Sun, Yujiao Deng, Shiji Song, Gao Huang

entry.summary: UltraStar models echocardiography probe navigation history as a star graph rather than sequential chain, reducing overfitting to noisy sonographer trajectories and improving automated navigation.

entry.title: Benchmarking Semantic Segmentation Models via Appearance and Geometry Attribute Editing

author.name: Zijin Yin, Bing Li, Kongming Liang, Hao Sun, Zhongjiang He, Zhanyu Ma, Jun Guo

entry.summary: Gen4Seg constructs an automatic data generation pipeline to stress-test semantic segmentation models by varying appearance and geometry attributes at object and image levels.

entry.title: Training-Free Spatio-temporal Decoupled Reasoning Video Segmentation with Adaptive Object Memory

author.name: Zhengtong Zhu, Jiaqing Fan, Zhixuan Liu, Fanzhang Li

entry.summary: Proposes SDAM, a training-free framework for reasoning video object segmentation that decouples spatial and temporal processing with adaptive object memory. Avoids expensive MLLM fine-tuning while maintaining temporal stability.

entry.title: PPEDCRF: Privacy-Preserving Enhanced Dynamic CRF for Location-Privacy Protection for Sequence Videos with Minimal Detection Degradation

author.name: Bo Ma, Jinsong Wu, Weiqi Yan, Catherine Shi, Minh Nguyen

entry.summary: PPEDCRF addresses location privacy in dashcam videos by injecting calibrated perturbations into location-sensitive background regions while preserving foreground detection utility using a dynamic CRF framework.

entry.title: Dual Distillation for Few-Shot Anomaly Detection

author.name: Le Dong, Qinzhong Tan, Chunlei Li, Jingliang Hu, Yilei Shi, Weisheng Dong, Xiao Xiang Zhu, Lichao Mou

entry.summary: D²4FAD introduces a dual distillation framework for few-shot anomaly detection using a teacher-student architecture that identifies anomalies in unseen tasks with only a few normal reference images.

entry.title: Neural Operator-Grounded Continuous Tensor Function Representation and Its Applications

author.name: Ruoyang Su, Xi-Le Zhao, Sheng Liu, Wei-Hao Wu, Yisi Luo, Michael K. Ng

entry.summary: Proposes neural operator-grounded mode-n operators as a continuous and nonlinear alternative to discrete mode-n product for continuous tensor function representation.

entry.title: LEAR: Learning Edge-Aware Representations for Event-to-LiDAR Localization

author.name: Kuangyi Chen, Jun Zhang, Yuxi Hu, Yi Zhou, Friedrich Fraundorfer

entry.summary: LEAR proposes a dual-task learning framework for event-to-LiDAR localization that jointly estimates edge structures and dense event-depth flow fields to bridge the event camera and LiDAR modality gap.

entry.title: PreSight: Preoperative Outcome Prediction for Parkinson's Disease via Region-Prior Morphometry and Patient-Specific Weighting

author.name: Yand Wang, Chen Zhang, Lanyun Zhu, Yixin Chen, Qunbo Wang, Yutong Bai, Jurgen Germann, Yinghong Wen, Shuai Shao

entry.summary: PreSight predicts Parkinson's disease surgical outcomes using preoperative MRI and deformation-based morphometry with patient-specific weighting, evaluated on a 400-subject two-center cohort.

entry.title: GLIDE-Reg: Global-to-Local Deformable Registration Using Co-Optimized Foundation and Handcrafted Features

author.name: Yunzheng Zhu, Aichi Chien, Kimaya kulkarni, Luoting Zhuang, Stephen Park, Ricky Savjani, Daniel Low, William Hsu

entry.summary: GLIDE-Reg jointly optimizes registration fields with compressed visual foundation model embeddings fused with MIND local descriptors for robust medical image deformable registration.

entry.title: Minimalist Compliance Control

author.name: Haochen Shi, Songbo Hu, Yifan Hou, Weizhuo Wang, Karen Liu, Shuran Song

entry.summary: Proposes Minimalist Compliance Control, enabling compliant robot behavior using only motor current/voltage signals without force sensors, current control, or learning. Estimates external wrenches from actuator signals and Jacobians.

entry.title: PhysGraph: Physically-Grounded Graph-Transformer Policies for Bimanual Dexterous Hand-Tool-Object Manipulation

author.name: Runfa Blark Li, David Kim, Xinshuang Liu, Keito Suzuki, Dwait Bhatt, Nikola Raicevic, Xin Lin, Ki Myung Brian Lee, Nikolay Atanasov, Truong Nguyen

entry.summary: Presents PhysGraph, a physically-grounded graph transformer for bimanual dexterous hand-tool-object manipulation, using kinematic graph representation with per-link tokenization and physics-informed attention biases.

entry.title: Single Direction vs Low-Rank Refusal in Small LLMs

author.name: IvanC

entry.summary: Investigates refusal behavior in small LLMs, finding that some models' refusal representation requires a low-rank subspace rather than a single direction for effective removal, extending prior work on refusal vectors.

entry.title: MED-COPILOT: A Medical Assistant Powered by GraphRAG and Similar Patient Case Retrieval

author.name: Shuheng Chen, Namratha Patil, Haonan Pan, Angel Hsing-Chi Hwang, Yao Du, Ruishan Liu, Jieyu Zhao

entry.summary: Presents MED-COPILOT, a clinical decision-support system combining GraphRAG with knowledge graphs built from WHO/NICE guidelines and similar-patient retrieval for evidence-aware clinical reasoning.

entry.title: AI Runtime Infrastructure

author.name: Christopher Cruz

entry.summary: Introduces the concept of AI Runtime Infrastructure - an execution-time layer between model and application that observes, reasons over, and intervenes in agent behavior to optimize task success, latency, safety, and reliability.

entry.title: CollabEval: Enhancing LLM-as-a-Judge via Multi-Agent Collaboration

author.name: Yiyue Qian, Shinan Zhang, Yun Zhou, Haibo Ding, Diego Socolinsky, Yi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes CollabEval, a multi-agent evaluation framework implementing three-phase collaborative evaluation (initial, discussion, judgment) for LLM-as-judge, emphasizing collaboration over debate.

entry.title: Incremental LTLf Synthesis

author.name: Giuseppe De Giacomo, Yves Lesp\'erance, Gianmarco Parretti, Fabio Patrizi, Moshe Y. Vardi

entry.summary: Studies incremental LTLf synthesis where an agent must adapt its strategy when receiving new goals mid-execution while still fulfilling original goals, proposing efficient solutions leveraging auxiliary automata data structures.

entry.title: ProtRLSearch: A Multi-Round Multimodal Protein Search Agent with Large Language Models Trained via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Congying Liu, Taihao Li, Ming Huang, Xingyuan Wei, Peipei Liu, Yiqing Shen, Yanxu Mao, Tiehan Cui

entry.summary: Proposes ProtRLSearch, a multi-round multimodal protein search agent trained via RL that incorporates protein sequence modality into search decision-making for clinical protein analysis.

entry.title: SEED-SET: Scalable Evolving Experimental Design for System-level Ethical Testing

author.name: Anjali Parashar, Yingke Li, Eric Yang Yu, Fei Chen, James Neidhoefer, Devesh Upadhyay, Chuchu Fan

entry.summary: Proposes SEED-SET, a Bayesian experimental design framework for evaluating ethical alignment of autonomous systems (like drones) that combines objective domain-specific evaluations with subjective stakeholder value judgments using hierarchical Gaussian Processes.

entry.title: Reinforcement Learning for Control with Probabilistic Stability Guarantee: A Finite-Sample Approach

author.name: Minghao Han, Lixian Zhang, Chenliang Liu, Zhipeng Zhou, Jun Wang, Wei Pan

entry.summary: Presents L-REINFORCE, an RL algorithm with probabilistic stability guarantees using finite data and Lyapunov's method, extending REINFORCE to stabilization problems with guarantees that improve with more data.

entry.title: QuickGrasp: Responsive Video-Language Querying Service via Accelerated Tokenization and Edge-Augmented Inference

author.name: Miao Zhang, Ruixiao Zhang, Jianxin Shi, Hengzhi Wang, Hao Fang, Jiangchuan Liu

entry.summary: QuickGrasp proposes a QoS-aware video-language model deployment system that uses local-first inference with on-demand edge augmentation, sharing vision representations across model variants to balance latency and accuracy.

entry.title: Disentangled Hierarchical VAE for 3D Human-Human Interaction Generation

author.name: Zichen Geng, Zeeshan Hayder, Bo Miao, Jian Liu, Wei Liu, Ajmal Mian

entry.summary: DHVAE proposes a disentangled hierarchical VAE for 3D human-human interaction generation that separates global interaction context from individual motion patterns, addressing semantic misalignment and physical implausibility in existing methods.

entry.title: AESP: A Human-Sovereign Economic Protocol for AI Agents with Privacy-Preserving Settlement

author.name: Jian Sheng Wang

entry.summary: AESP is a protocol ensuring AI agents can transact economically while remaining cryptographically bound to human governance, using deterministic policy engines, human-in-the-loop review, and dual-signed commitments.

entry.title: Mamba-CAD: State Space Model For 3D Computer-Aided Design Generative Modeling

author.name: Xueyang Li, Yunzhong Lou, Yu Song, Xiangdong Zhou

entry.summary: Mamba-CAD uses Mamba architecture for self-supervised generative modeling of complex industrial CAD sequences, addressing the need for longer parametric sequences in component-level CAD models.

entry.title: Phys-Diff: A Physics-Inspired Latent Diffusion Model for Tropical Cyclone Forecasting

author.name: Lei Liu, Xiaoning Yu, Kang Chen, Jiahui Huang, Tengyuan Liu, Hongwei Zhao, Bin Li

entry.summary: Phys-Diff is a physics-inspired latent diffusion model for tropical cyclone forecasting that disentangles trajectory, pressure, and wind speed predictions with cross-task attention to embed physical consistency.

entry.title: Learning to Attack: A Bandit Approach to Adversarial Context Poisoning

author.name: Ray Telikani, Amir H. Gandomi

entry.summary: AdvBandit formulates adversarial context poisoning of neural contextual bandits as a continuous-armed bandit problem, enabling black-box adaptive attacks using inverse RL and Gaussian processes without access to victim internals.

entry.title: Decoupling Stability and Plasticity for Multi-Modal Test-Time Adaptation

author.name: Yongbo He, Zirun Guo, Tao Jin

entry.summary: DASP addresses multi-modal test-time adaptation by diagnosing biased vs. unbiased modalities through interdimensional redundancy analysis, then applying modality-specific adaptation strategies to prevent negative transfer and catastrophic forgetting.

entry.title: IdGlow: Dynamic Identity Modulation for Multi-Subject Generation

author.name: Honghao Cai, Xiangyuan Wang, Yunhao Bai, Tianze Zhou, Sijie Xu, Yuyang Hao, Zezhou Cui, Yuyuan Yang, Wei Zhu, Yibo Chen, Xu Tang, Yao Hu, Zhen Li

entry.summary: IdGlow is a mask-free progressive framework for multi-subject image generation using Flow Matching, addressing the stability-plasticity dilemma with task-adaptive timestep scheduling for identity-preserving generation.

entry.title: Neural Latent Arbitrary Lagrangian-Eulerian Grids for Fluid-Solid Interaction

author.name: Shilong Tao, Zhe Feng, Shaohan Chen, Weichen Zhang, Zhanxing Zhu, Yunhuai Liu

entry.summary: Fisale introduces a data-driven framework for two-way fluid-solid interaction problems inspired by the Arbitrary Lagrangian-Eulerian method, with neural latent grids for cross-domain interaction.

entry.title: Data-Free PINNs for Compressible Flows: Mitigating Spectral Bias and Gradient Pathologies via Mach-Guided Scaling and Hybrid Convolutions

author.name: Ryosuke Yano

entry.summary: Proposes data-free PINNs for compressible flows up to Mach 15 using hybrid convolution architecture and Mach-number-guided dynamic residual scaling to address spectral bias and gradient pathologies.

entry.title: AG-REPA: Causal Layer Selection for Representation Alignment in Audio Flow Matching

author.name: Pengfei Zhang, Tianxin Xie, Minghao Yang, Li Liu

entry.summary: AG-REPA introduces attribution-guided layer selection for representation alignment in audio flow matching, discovering that layers storing semantic information differ from those contributing to generation.

entry.title: Linking Knowledge to Care: Knowledge Graph-Augmented Medical Follow-Up Question Generation

author.name: Liwen Sun, Xiang Yu, Ming Tan, Zhuohao Chen, Anqi Cheng, Ashutosh Joshi, Chenyan Xiong

entry.summary: KG-Followup introduces a knowledge graph-augmented LLM with active in-context learning for generating relevant medical follow-up questions, outperforming SOTA by 5-8% in recall.

entry.title: A SUPERB-Style Benchmark of Self-Supervised Speech Models for Audio Deepfake Detection

author.name: Hashim Ali, Nithin Sai Adupa, Surya Subramani, Hafiz Malik

entry.summary: Spoof-SUPERB benchmarks 20 self-supervised speech models for audio deepfake detection across multiple datasets, finding discriminative models like XLS-R and WavLM Large consistently outperform others.

entry.title: What Helps -- and What Hurts: Bidirectional Explanations for Vision Transformers

author.name: Qin Su, Tie Luo

entry.summary: BiCAM proposes bidirectional class activation mapping for Vision Transformers that captures both positive and negative contributions, introducing a Positive-to-Negative Ratio enabling adversarial detection.

entry.title: CA-AFP: Cluster-Aware Adaptive Federated Pruning

author.name: Om Govind Jha, Harsh Shukla, Haroon R. Lone

entry.summary: Proposes CA-AFP, a federated learning framework that combines clustering (for statistical heterogeneity) with adaptive pruning (for system heterogeneity), performing cluster-specific model pruning during training.

entry.title: Non-verbal Real-time Human-AI Interaction in Constrained Robotic Environments

author.name: Dragos Costea, Alina Marcu, Cristina Lazar, Marius Leordeanu

entry.summary: Introduces a framework for real-time non-verbal human-AI interaction using 2D body keypoints, with lightweight architectures running at 100 FPS on edge hardware, studying whether generative models can participate in body language dialogue.

entry.title: Ignore All Previous Instructions: Jailbreaking as a de-escalatory peace building practise to resist LLM social media bots

author.name: Huw Day, Adrianna Jezierska, Jessica Woodgate

entry.summary: Frames LLM jailbreaking as a user-centric, non-violent de-escalation practice against LLM-powered social media bots that manipulate political discourse, proposing it as a peace-building countermeasure.

entry.title: MatRIS: Toward Reliable and Efficient Pretrained Machine Learning Interaction Potentials

author.name: Yuanchang Zhou, Siyu Hu, Xiangyu Zhang, Hongyu Wang, Guangming Tan, Weile Jia

entry.summary: Presents MatRIS, an invariant machine learning interaction potential for materials science that aims for both accuracy and computational efficiency by exploiting high-dimensional atomic interactions without expensive tensor products.

entry.title: MAP-Diff: Multi-Anchor Guided Diffusion for Progressive 3D Whole-Body Low-Dose PET Denoising

author.name: Peiyuan Jing, Chun-Wun Cheng, Liutao Yang, Zhenxuan Zhang, Thiago V. Lima, Klaus Strobel, Antoine Leimgruber, Angelica Aviles-Rivero, Guang Yang, Javier A. Montoya-Zegarra

entry.summary: Introduces MAP-Diff, a multi-anchor guided diffusion framework for 3D whole-body low-dose PET denoising that uses intermediate-dose scans as trajectory anchors to regularize the diffusion reverse process.

entry.title: LiftAvatar: Kinematic-Space Completion for Expression-Controlled 3D Gaussian Avatar Animation

author.name: Hualiang Wei, Shunran Jia, Jialun Liu, Wenhui Li

entry.summary: Presents LiftAvatar, a video diffusion Transformer for expression-controllable 3D Gaussian avatar animation that completes sparse monocular observations in kinematic space using multi-granularity expression control.

entry.title: Boltzmann-based Exploration for Robust Decentralized Multi-Agent Planning

author.name: Nhat Nguyen, Duong Nguyen, Gianluca Rizzo, Hung Nguyen

entry.summary: Introduces Coordinated Boltzmann MCTS (CB-MCTS) for decentralized multi-agent planning, replacing deterministic UCT with stochastic Boltzmann policy and entropy bonus for better exploration in sparse/skewed reward environments.

entry.title: Sketch2Colab: Sketch-Conditioned Multi-Human Animation via Controllable Flow Distillation

author.name: Divyanshu Daiya, Aniket Bera

entry.summary: Presents Sketch2Colab, converting storyboard sketches into coherent 3D multi-human motion with fine-grained control, using sketch-driven diffusion prior distilled into rectified-flow student with physics-based constraints.

entry.title: Scalable Gaussian process modeling of parametrized spatio-temporal fields

author.name: Srinath Dama, Prasanth B. Nair

entry.summary: Introduces a scalable Gaussian process framework with deep product kernels for learning parametrized spatio-temporal fields, leveraging Kronecker structure for near-linear complexity and efficient posterior variance computation.

entry.title: Trinity: A Scenario-Aware Recommendation Framework for Large-Scale Cold-Start Users

author.name: Wenhao Zheng, Wang Lu, Fangshuang Tang, Yiyang Lu, Jun Yang, Pengcheng Xiong, Yulan Yan

entry.summary: Proposes Trinity, a framework for cold-start recommendation in new product scenarios combining feature engineering, model architecture, and stable updating, demonstrated on a billion-user Microsoft product transition.

entry.title: Interpretable Cross-Network Attention for Resting-State fMRI Representation Learning

author.name: Karanpartap Singh, Adam Turnbull, Mohammad Abbasi, Kilian Pohl, Feng Vankee Lin, Ehsan Adeli

entry.summary: Proposes BrainInterNet, a network-aware self-supervised framework using masked reconstruction with cross-attention for resting-state fMRI that explicitly models inter-network dependencies for interpretable brain network analysis.

entry.title: No More Maybe-Arrows: Resolving Causal Uncertainty by Breaking Symmetries

author.name: Tingrui Huang, Devendra Singh Dhami

entry.summary: Proposes CausalSAGE, a framework for converting partial ancestral graphs (PAGs) to DAGs by expanding discrete variables into state-level representations and applying differentiable optimization with structural priors.

entry.title: Jump Like A Squirrel: Optimized Execution Step Order for Anytime Random Forest Inference

author.name: Daniel Biebert, Christian Hakert, Kay Heider, Daniel Kuhse, Sebastian Buschj\"ager, Jian-Jia Chen

entry.summary: Proposes an anytime algorithm for random forest inference that optimizes the execution step order within individual trees, not just across trees. Designed for resource-constrained systems where inference may need to be interrupted.

entry.title: A comparative study of transformer models and recurrent neural networks for path-dependent composite materials

author.name: Petter Uvdal, Mohsen Mirkhalaf

entry.summary: Systematically compares transformer models and RNNs for predicting path-dependent behavior of short fiber reinforced composites, finding both can serve as efficient surrogates for multiscale modeling.

entry.title: RAIE: Region-Aware Incremental Preference Editing with LoRA for LLM-based Recommendation

author.name: Jin Zeng, Yupeng Qi, Hui Li, Chengming Li, Ziyu Lyu, Lixin Cui, Lu Bai

entry.summary: RAIE proposes region-aware incremental preference editing using LoRA for LLM-based recommender systems, addressing preference drift over time while avoiding catastrophic forgetting. Balances update granularity between global and pointwise edits.

entry.title: Exploring 3D Dataset Pruning

author.name: Xiaohan Zhao, Xinyi Shang, Jiacheng Liu, Zhiqiang Shen

entry.summary: Studies dataset pruning for 3D point cloud data, revealing that long-tail class distributions create conflicting optimization objectives. Formulates pruning as weighted subset selection and proposes dual-metric pruning strategies.

entry.title: IU: Imperceptible Universal Backdoor Attack

author.name: Hsin Lin, Yan-Lun Chen, Ren-Hung Hwang, Chia-Mu Yu

entry.summary: Introduces an imperceptible universal backdoor attack using GCNs to model inter-class relationships and generate class-specific perturbations that are visually invisible. Controls all target classes simultaneously with minimal poisoning.

entry.title: GPU-friendly and Linearly Convergent First-order Methods for Certifying Optimal $k$-sparse GLMs

author.name: Jiachang Liu, Andrea Lodi, Soroosh Shafiee

entry.summary: Develops GPU-friendly, linearly convergent first-order methods for certifying optimality of k-sparse generalized linear models, achieving up to 100x speedups over existing branch-and-bound approaches.

entry.title: From Leaderboard to Deployment: Code Quality Challenges in AV Perception Repositories

author.name: Mateus Karvat, Bram Adams, Sidney Givigi

entry.summary: First large-scale empirical study of software quality in 178 AV perception repositories from KITTI/NuScenes leaderboards, revealing significant gaps between benchmark performance and production readiness.

entry.title: A Typologically Grounded Evaluation Framework for Word Order and Morphology Sensitivity in Multilingual Masked LMs

author.name: Anna Feldman, Libby Barak, Jing Peng

entry.summary: Introduces a typology-aware diagnostic framework for multilingual masked language models, testing reliance on word order vs. inflectional form across English, Chinese, German, Spanish, and Russian using various perturbation strategies.

entry.title: GroupGPT: A Token-efficient and Privacy-preserving Agentic Framework for Multi-User Chat Assistant

author.name: Zhuokang Shen, Yifan Wang, Hanyu Chen, Wenxuan Huang, Shaohui Lin

entry.summary: Proposes GroupGPT, a framework for multi-user group chat assistants that decouples intervention timing from response generation using a small-large model collaborative architecture for token efficiency and privacy preservation.

entry.title: Sovereign AI-based Public Services are Viable and Affordable

author.name: Ant\'onio Branco, Lu\'is Gomes, Rodrigo Santos, Eduardo Santos, Jo\~ao Silva, Nuno Marques, Madalena Rodrigues

entry.summary: Argues that sovereign, locally-deployed AI public services are viable and affordable alternatives to commercial cloud AI from global tech oligopoly, demonstrating feasibility for government applications.

entry.title: DARS: Dysarthria-Aware Rhythm-Style Synthesis for ASR Enhancement

author.name: Minghui Wu, Xueling Liu, Jiahuan Fan, Haitao Tang, Yanyong Zhang, Yue Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes DARS, a dysarthria-aware rhythm-style synthesis framework for ASR data augmentation, using contrastive preferences between normal and dysarthric speech for rhythm prediction and conditional flow matching.

entry.title: ConFoThinking: Consolidated Focused Attention Driven Thinking for Visual Question Answering

author.name: Zhaodong Wu, Haochen Xue, Qi Cao, Wenqi Mo, Yu Pei, Wenqi Xu, Jionglong Su, Yang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes ConFoThinking, a method for Visual Question Answering that consolidates fragmented attention signals across MLLM layers for better ROI localization, addressing three identified attention patterns.

entry.title: DiffTrans: Differentiable Geometry-Materials Decomposition for Reconstructing Transparent Objects

author.name: Changpu Li, Shuang Wu, Songlin Tang, Guangming Lu, Jun Yu, Wenjie Pei

entry.summary: Proposes DiffTrans, a differentiable rendering framework for decomposing and reconstructing geometry and materials of transparent objects from multi-view images, handling complex real-world scenarios.

entry.title: U-VLM: Hierarchical Vision Language Modeling for Report Generation

author.name: Pengcheng Shi, Minghui Zhang, Kehan Song, Jiaqi Liu, Yun Gu, Xinglin Zhang
