entry.summary: Proposes U-VLM for radiology report generation using hierarchical vision-language modeling with progressive training (segmentation→classification→report) and multi-layer visual injection from U-Net encoders.

entry.title: Cross-Scale Pansharpening via ScaleFormer and the PanScale Benchmark

author.name: Ke Cao, Xuanhua He, Xueheng Li, Lingting Zhu, Yingying Wang, Ao Ma, Zhanjie Zhang, Man Zhou, Chengjun Xie, Jie Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces PanScale, the first large-scale cross-scale pansharpening dataset and benchmark, along with ScaleFormer architecture for generalization across varying resolutions.

entry.title: RC-GeoCP: Geometric Consensus for Radar-Camera Collaborative Perception

author.name: Xiaokai Bai, Lianqing Zheng, Runwei Guan, Siyuan Cao, Huiliang Shen

entry.summary: Introduces RC-GeoCP, the first framework exploring 4D radar and camera fusion for collaborative perception, establishing radar-anchored geometric consensus for cross-agent alignment.

entry.title: MMTA: Multi Membership Temporal Attention for Fine-Grained Stroke Rehabilitation Assessment

author.name: Halil Ismail Helvaci, Justin Huber, Jihye Bae, Sen-ching Samson Cheung

entry.summary: MMTA introduces a temporal attention mechanism for fine-grained stroke rehabilitation assessment that allows each frame to attend to multiple locally normalized contexts. Targets sub-second micro-movement segmentation in therapy videos.

entry.title: Dr.Occ: Depth- and Region-Guided 3D Occupancy from Surround-View Cameras for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Xubo Zhu, Haoyang Zhang, Fei He, Rui Wu, Yanhu Shan, Wen Yang, Huai Yu

entry.summary: Dr.Occ proposes depth- and region-guided 3D occupancy prediction for autonomous driving, using dense depth cues from MoGe-2 for geometric alignment and region-aware semantic supervision to handle class imbalance.

entry.title: HeroGS: Hierarchical Guidance for Robust 3D Gaussian Splatting under Sparse Views

author.name: Jiashu Li, Xumeng Han, Zhaoyang Wei, Zipeng Wang, Kuiran Wang, Guorong Li, Zhenjun Han, Jianbin Jiao

entry.summary: HeroGS introduces hierarchical guidance at image, feature, and parameter levels for 3D Gaussian Splatting under sparse views, converting sparse supervision into pseudo-dense guidance.

entry.title: Teacher-Guided Causal Interventions for Image Denoising: Orthogonal Content-Noise Disentanglement in Vision Transformers

author.name: Kuai Jiang, Zhaoyan Ding, Guijuan Zhang, Dianjie Lu, Zhuoran Zheng

entry.summary: TCD-Net proposes teacher-guided causal interventions for image denoising within Vision Transformers, explicitly decomposing content from noise through structured interventions on feature spaces.

entry.title: Deepfake Forensics Adapter: A Dual-Stream Network for Generalizable Deepfake Detection

author.name: Jianfeng Liao, Yichen Wei, Raymond Chan Ching Bon, Shulan Wang, Kam-Pui Chow, Kwok-Yan Lam

entry.summary: DFA presents a dual-stream deepfake detection framework combining CLIP with forensics-specific adapters, including global feature adaptation, frequency analysis, and multi-scale residual learning.

entry.title: SCATR: Mitigating New Instance Suppression in LiDAR-based Tracking-by-Attention via Second Chance Assignment and Track Query Dropout

author.name: Brian Cheong, Letian Wang, Sandro Papais, Steven L. Waslander

entry.summary: SCATR addresses new instance suppression in LiDAR tracking-by-attention via Second Chance Assignment and Track Query Dropout, two architecture-agnostic training strategies.

entry.title: Cryo-Bench: Benchmarking Foundation Models for Cryosphere Applications

author.name: Saurabh Kaushik, Lalit Maurya, Beth Tellman

entry.summary: Cryo-Bench is a new benchmark for evaluating geo-foundation models on cryosphere applications including glaciers, glacial lakes, sea ice, and calving fronts. Evaluates 14 GFMs across multiple sensors and regions.

entry.title: Coarse-to-Fine Monocular Re-Localization in OpenStreetMap via Semantic Alignment

author.name: Yuchen Zou, Xiao Hu, Dexing Zhong, Yuqing Tang

entry.summary: Proposes a coarse-to-fine monocular re-localization framework using OpenStreetMap as a lightweight, privacy-preserving map alternative, leveraging DINO-ViT for semantic alignment.

entry.title: Preoperative-to-intraoperative Liver Registration for Laparoscopic Surgery via Latent-Grounded Correspondence Constraints

author.name: Ruize Cui, Jialun Pei, Haiqiao Wang, Jun Zhou, Jeremy Yuen-Chun Teoh, Pheng-Ann Heng, Jing Qin

entry.summary: Land-Reg introduces a correspondence-driven deformable registration framework for laparoscopic liver surgery that learns latent-grounded 2D-3D landmark correspondences for interpretable cross-modal alignment.

entry.title: Action-Guided Attention for Video Action Anticipation

author.name: Tsung-Ming Tai, Sofia Casarin, Andrea Pilzer, Werner Nutt, Oswald Lanz

entry.summary: Action-Guided Attention (AGA) proposes using predicted action sequences as queries in attention mechanisms for video action anticipation, providing high-level semantic guidance beyond pixel representations.

entry.title: ORGAN: Object-Centric Representation Learning using Cycle Consistent Generative Adversarial Networks

author.name: Jo\"el K\"uchler, Ellen van Maren, Vaiva Vasiliauskait\.e, Katarina Vuli\'c, Reza Abbasi-Asl, Stephan J. Ihle

entry.summary: ORGAN applies cycle-consistent GANs to object-centric representation learning as an alternative to autoencoder-based approaches, showing competitive performance with improved handling of textured backgrounds.

entry.title: HiFi-Inpaint: Towards High-Fidelity Reference-Based Inpainting for Generating Detail-Preserving Human-Product Images

author.name: Yichen Liu, Donghao Zhou, Jie Wang, Xin Gao, Guisheng Liu, Jiatong Li, Quanwei Zhang, Qiang Lyu, Lanqing Guo, Shilei Wen, Weiqiang Wang, Pheng-Ann Heng

entry.summary: HiFi-Inpaint proposes high-fidelity reference-based inpainting for generating human-product images with precise product detail preservation for advertising and e-commerce.

entry.title: EgoMoD: Predicting Global Maps of Dynamics from Local Egocentric Observations

author.name: Iacopo Catalano, David Morilla-Cabello, Jorge Pena-Queralta, Eduardo Montijano

entry.summary: Introduces EgoMoD, the first approach to predict environment-wide Maps of Dynamics from short egocentric video clips during robot operation. Enables anticipatory navigation planning in crowded scenes beyond the robot's perceptual range.

entry.title: Pro-HOI: Perceptive Root-guided Humanoid-Object Interaction

author.name: Yuhang Lin, Jiyuan Shi, Dewei Wang, Jipeng Kong, Yong Liu, Chenjia Bai, Xuelong Li

entry.summary: Introduces Pro-HOI, a framework for humanoid-object interaction that conditions policy on root trajectory and uses SDF loss for contact optimization. Demonstrates robust humanoid loco-manipulation including box carrying.

entry.title: riMESA: Consensus ADMM for Real-World Collaborative SLAM

author.name: Daniel McGann, Michael Kaess

entry.summary: Proposes riMESA, a robust incremental distributed SLAM backend using consensus ADMM that handles outliers, limited communication, and online operation for multi-robot teams.

entry.title: ROSER: Few-Shot Robotic Sequence Retrieval for Scalable Robot Learning

author.name: Zillur Rahman, Eddison Pham, Alejandro Daniel Noel, Cristian Meo

entry.summary: Introduces ROSER, a few-shot robotic sequence retrieval framework that extracts task-centric segments from unlabeled interaction logs using learned metric spaces over temporal windows, requiring as few as a single reference.

entry.title: CHOP: Counterfactual Human Preference Labels Improve Obstacle Avoidance in Visuomotor Navigation Policies

author.name: Gershom Seneviratne, Jianyu An, Vaibhav Shende, Sahire Ellahy, Yaxita Amin, Kondapi Manasanjani, Samarth Chopra, Jonathan Deepak Kannan, Dinesh Manocha

entry.summary: Introduces CHOP, using counterfactual human preference labels where annotators compare alternative trajectories the robot could have followed, aligning visuomotor navigation policies with human safety intuition.

entry.title: RoboGPU: Accelerating GPU Collision Detection for Robotics

author.name: Lufei Liu, Liwei Xue, Youssef Mohammed, Jocelyn Zhao, Yuan Hsi Chou, Tor M. Aamodt

entry.summary: Proposes RoboGPU, enhancing GPU ray tracing accelerator units for robotics collision detection, showing GPUs can efficiently handle collision detection with hardware modifications.

entry.title: Confusion-Aware Rubric Optimization for LLM-based Automated Grading

author.name: Yucheng Chu, Hang Li, Kaiqi Yang, Yasemin Copur-Gencturk, Joseph Krajcik, Namsoo Shin, Jiliang Tang

entry.summary: Introduces CARO, a framework for optimizing LLM grading rubrics that addresses 'rule dilution' where conflicting constraints from aggregated error samples weaken grading logic. Uses confusion-aware clustering to organize errors before updating rubrics.

entry.title: EMPA: Evaluating Persona-Aligned Empathy as a Process

author.name: Shiya Zhang, Yuhan Zhan, Ruixi Su, Ruihan Sun, Ziyi Song, Zhaohan Chen, Xiaofan Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces EMPA, a process-oriented framework evaluating persona-aligned empathy in LLM dialogue agents as sustained intervention trajectories rather than isolated replies, scoring in latent psychological space.

entry.title: HVR-Met: A Hypothesis-Verification-Replaning Agentic System for Extreme Weather Diagnosis

author.name: Shuo Tang, Jiadong Zhang, Jian Xu, Gengxian Zhou, Qizhao Jin, Qinxuan Wang, Yi Hu, Ning Hu, Hongchang Ren, Lingli He, Jiaolan Fu, Jingtao Ding, Shiming Xiang, Chenglin Liu

entry.summary: Proposes HVR-Met, a multi-agent system for extreme weather diagnosis using hypothesis-verification-replanning cycles with expert knowledge integration and professional-grade iterative reasoning.

entry.title: The Observer-Situation Lattice: A Unified Formal Basis for Perspective-Aware Cognition

author.name: Saad Alqithami

entry.summary: Introduces Observer-Situation Lattice (OSL), a unified mathematical structure for perspective-aware cognition in multi-agent systems, providing a single semantic space for reasoning about beliefs across agents, times, and contexts.

entry.title: Benchmarking LLM Summaries of Multimodal Clinical Time Series for Remote Monitoring

author.name: Aditya Shukla, Yining Yuan, Ben Tamo, Yifei Wang, Micky Nnamdi, Shaun Tan, Jieru Li, Benoit Marteau, Brad Willingham, May Wang

entry.summary: Introduces an event-based evaluation framework for LLM-generated clinical summaries of multimodal time series data, using a dementia monitoring dataset. The framework measures whether summaries faithfully capture clinically significant events like sustained abnormalities, addressing a gap where existing metrics focus only on semantic similarity.

entry.title: Econometric vs. Causal Structure-Learning for Time-Series Policy Decisions: Evidence from the UK COVID-19 Policies

author.name: Bruno Petrungaro, Anthony C. Constantinou

entry.summary: Compares econometric and causal structure-learning methods for recovering causal structures from time series data, using UK COVID-19 policy data as a case study.

entry.title: M3-AD: Reflection-aware Multi-modal, Multi-category, and Multi-dimensional Benchmark and Framework for Industrial Anomaly Detection

author.name: Chao Huang, Yanhui Li, Yunkang Cao, Wei Wang, Hongxi Huang, Jie Wen, Wenqi Ren, Xiaochun Cao

entry.summary: Proposes M3-AD, a reflection-aware multimodal framework for industrial anomaly detection using MLLMs, with RA-Monitor for self-correction and a benchmark covering multiple categories and dimensions.

entry.title: AdURA-Net: Adaptive Uncertainty and Region-Aware Network

author.name: Antik Aich Roy, Ujjwal Bhattacharya

entry.summary: AdURA-Net addresses uncertainty handling in clinical decision-making for multi-label chest X-ray datasets, allowing models to express uncertainty rather than forcing confident predictions.

entry.title: Personalities at Play: Probing Alignment in AI Teammates

author.name: Mohammad Amin Samadi, Nia Nixon

entry.summary: Studies AI personality alignment through self-perception, behavioral expression, and reflective expression across GPT-4o, Claude-3.7, Gemini-2.5 Pro, and Grok-3, examining Big Five personality traits in LLM teammates.

entry.title: TAP-SLF: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Vision Foundation Models for Multi-Task Ultrasound Image Analysis

author.name: Hui Wan, Libin Lan

entry.summary: TAP-SLF proposes task-aware prompting and selective layer fine-tuning for adapting vision foundation models to multiple ultrasound analysis tasks simultaneously, addressing the gap between task-agnostic adaptation and task-specific needs.

entry.title: RAISE: Requirement-Adaptive Evolutionary Refinement for Training-Free Text-to-Image Alignment

author.name: Liyao Jiang, Ruichen Chen, Chao Gao, Di Niu

entry.summary: RAISE is a training-free evolutionary framework for improving text-to-image alignment that adapts iteration budgets to prompt difficulty, avoiding the need for curated reflection datasets or fine-tuning.

entry.title: Enhancing Molecular Property Predictions by Learning from Bond Modelling and Interactions

author.name: Yunqing Liu, Yi Zhou, Wenqi Fan

entry.summary: DeMol introduces a dual-graph framework for molecular representation learning that models both atom-centric and bond-centric perspectives, addressing limitations of conventional approaches that overlook bond-level phenomena like resonance.

entry.title: AlignVAR: Towards Globally Consistent Visual Autoregression for Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Cencen Liu (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China), Dongyang Zhang (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, Ubiquitous Intelligence and Trusted Services Key Laboratory of Sichuan Province), Wen Yin (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China), Jielei Wang (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, Ubiquitous Intelligence and Trusted Services Key Laboratory of Sichuan Province), Tianyu Li (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China), Ji Guo (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China), Wenbo Jiang (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China), Guoqing Wang (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China), Guoming Lu (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, Ubiquitous Intelligence and Trusted Services Key Laboratory of Sichuan Province)

entry.summary: AlignVAR adapts Visual Autoregressive (VAR) models for image super-resolution with spatial consistency mechanisms and multi-scale supervision to address locality bias and error accumulation across scales.

entry.title: QANTIS: A Hardware-Validated Quantum Platform for POMDP Planning and Multi-Target Data Association

author.name: Bayram Y\"uksel Eker, Suayb S. Arslan, \"Ozg\"ur Nazl{\i}, Mustafa Serhat Demirgil, Furkan Delig\"oz

entry.summary: QANTIS is a quantum computing platform for POMDP planning and multi-target data association, using quantum amplitude amplification and QUBO reformulations, validated on real quantum hardware.

entry.title: TripleSumm: Adaptive Triple-Modality Fusion for Video Summarization

author.name: Sumin Kim, Hyemin Jeong, Mingu Kang, Yejin Kim, Yoori Oh, Joonseok Lee

entry.summary: TripleSumm proposes adaptive triple-modality (visual, text, audio) fusion for video summarization with frame-level modality weighting. Also introduces a new comprehensive benchmark for multimodal video summarization.

entry.title: AG-VAS: Anchor-Guided Zero-Shot Visual Anomaly Segmentation with Large Multimodal Models

author.name: Zhen Qu, Xian Tao, Xiaoyi Bao, Dingrong Wang, ShiChen Qu, Zhengtao Zhang, Xingang Wang

entry.summary: AG-VAS introduces anchor-guided zero-shot visual anomaly segmentation using large multimodal models with learnable semantic anchor tokens for anomaly detection.

entry.title: Constructing Synthetic Instruction Datasets for Improving Reasoning in Domain-Specific LLMs: A Case Study in the Japanese Financial Domain

author.name: Yuma Okochi, Fabio Milentiansen Sim, Tomoyasu Okada

entry.summary: Proposes a method for constructing synthetic instruction datasets for domain-specific LLMs starting from domain vocabulary, demonstrated in Japanese financial domain with 9.5B tokens including CoT traces.

entry.title: Enhancing Persona Following at Decoding Time via Dynamic Importance Estimation for Role-Playing Agents

author.name: Yuxin Liu, Mingye Zhu, Siyuan Liu, Bo Hu, Lei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes dynamic importance estimation for persona-following in role-playing agents at decoding time, grounded in psychological theory (Cognitive-Affective Personality Systems) for adaptive persona management.

entry.title: Retrieval, Refinement, and Ranking for Text-to-Video Generation via Prompt Optimization and Test-Time Scaling

author.name: Zillur Rahman, Alex Sheng, Cristian Meo

entry.summary: 3R introduces a RAG-based prompt optimization framework for text-to-video generation that requires no model training, using retrieval, refinement, and ranking to improve generation quality.

entry.title: Assessing Crime Disclosure Patterns in a Large-Scale Cybercrime Forum

author.name: Raphael Hoheisel, Tom Meurs, Jai Wientjes, Marianne Junger, Abhishta Abhishta, Masarah Paquet-Clouston

entry.summary: Large-scale analysis of crime disclosure patterns in a cybercrime forum using LLM-powered classification of 3.5M posts from 300K users, measuring evolution of criminal disclosure over time.

entry.title: PleaSQLarify: Visual Pragmatic Repair for Natural Language Database Querying

author.name: Robin Shing Moon Chan, Rita Sevastjanova, Mennatallah El-Assady

entry.summary: Presents PleaSQLarify, a system that reframes natural language database querying through pragmatic inference, using interactive clarification around interpretable decision variables to resolve ambiguity between user intent and SQL generation.

entry.title: Tide: A Customisable Dataset Generator for Anti-Money Laundering Research

author.name: Montijn van den Beukel, Jo\v{z}e Martin Ro\v{z}anec, Ana-Lucia Varbanescu

entry.summary: Presents Tide, an open-source synthetic dataset generator for anti-money laundering research that produces graph-based financial networks with both structural and temporal money laundering patterns.

entry.title: Demonstrating ViviDoc: Generating Interactive Documents through Human-Agent Collaboration

author.name: Yinghao Tang, Yupeng Xie, Yingchaojie Feng, Tingfeng Lan, Wei Chen

entry.summary: Presents ViviDoc, a human-agent collaborative system for generating interactive educational documents using a multi-agent pipeline with a human-readable Document Specification (DocSpec) intermediate representation.

entry.title: MAC: A Conversion Rate Prediction Benchmark Featuring Labels Under Multiple Attribution Mechanisms

author.name: Jinqi Wu, Sishuo Chen, Zhangming Chan, Yong Bai, Lei Zhang, Sheng Chen, Chenghuan Hou, Xiang-Rong Sheng, Han Zhu, Jian Xu, Bo Zheng, Chaoyou Fu

entry.summary: Establishes MAC, the first public conversion rate prediction dataset with labels from multiple attribution mechanisms, along with PyMAL library for multi-attribution learning research.

entry.title: Retrodictive Forecasting: A Proof-of-Concept for Exploiting Temporal Asymmetry in Time Series Prediction

author.name: Cedric Damour

entry.summary: Proposes retrodictive forecasting: instead of predicting future from past, identifies the future that best explains the present via inverse MAP optimization over a CVAE, with an information-theoretic diagnostic for applicability.

entry.title: Wave-Attractor-Tree: A Hierarchical Binary Tree Reduction Architecture for Efficient Sequence Modeling

author.name: Igor Berezkin

entry.summary: Proposes Wave-Attractor-Tree, a hierarchical binary tree reduction architecture replacing self-attention with recursive gated linear unit merges, achieving O(n) total operations and O(log n) parallel depth.

entry.title: Principled Fast and Meta Knowledge Learners for Continual Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ke Sun, Hongming Zhang, Jun Jin, Chao Gao, Xi Chen, Wulong Liu, Linglong Kong

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-learner framework inspired by hippocampus-cortex interplay for continual RL, with a fast learner for knowledge transfer and meta learner for knowledge integration that minimizes catastrophic forgetting.

entry.title: Fed-ADE: Adaptive Learning Rate for Federated Post-adaptation under Distribution Shift

author.name: Heewon Park, Mugon Joe, Miru Kim, Kyungjin Im, Minhae Kwon

entry.summary: Proposes Fed-ADE, a federated learning framework for post-deployment adaptation using uncertainty and representation dynamics estimation to automatically adjust learning rates per client under distribution shift.

entry.title: SKINOPATHY AI: Smartphone-Based Ophthalmic Screening and Longitudinal Tracking Using Lightweight Computer Vision

author.name: S. Kalaycioglu, C. Hong, M. Zhu, H. Xie

entry.summary: SKINOPATHY AI is a smartphone-based web application for ophthalmic screening using commodity mobile hardware, providing five screening modules including redness quantification and pupil reflex characterization.

entry.title: The Partition Principle Revisited: Non-Equal Volume Designs Achieve Minimal Expected Star Discrepancy

author.name: Xiaoda Xu

entry.summary: Proves that non-equal volume stratified sampling achieves lower expected star discrepancy than classical jittered sampling, with explicit improved upper bounds.

entry.title: On the Stability Connection Between Discrete-Time Algorithms and Their Resolution ODEs: Applications to Min-Max Optimisation

author.name: Amir Ali Farzin, Yuen-Man Pun, Philipp Braun, Iman Shames

entry.summary: Establishes rigorous connections between stability of discrete-time optimization algorithms and their continuous-time ODE approximations, proving exponential stability transfers under small step sizes.

entry.title: Building a Strong Instruction Language Model for a Less-Resourced Language

author.name: Domen Vre\v{s}, Tja\v{s}a Ar\v{c}on, Timotej Petri\v{c}, Dario Vajda, Marko Robnik-\v{S}ikonja, Iztok Lebar Bajec

entry.title: Graph neural network force fields for adiabatic dynamics of lattice Hamiltonians

author.name: Yunhao Fan, Gia-Wei Chern

entry.summary: Develops GNN-based force fields for adiabatic dynamics of lattice Hamiltonians, demonstrating on the semiclassical Holstein model with strict linear scaling and symmetry preservation through message passing.

entry.title: Piecing Together Cross-Document Coreference Resolution Datasets: Systematic Dataset Analysis and Unification

author.name: Anastasia Zhukova, Terry Ruas, Jan Philip Wahle, Bela Gipp

entry.summary: Introduces uCDCR, a unified dataset consolidating diverse cross-document coreference resolution corpora into a consistent format with standardized metrics, incorporating both entity and event coreference.

entry.title: Hybrid Neural-LLM Pipeline for Morphological Glossing in Endangered Language Documentation: A Case Study of Jungar Tuvan

author.name: Siyu Liang, Talant Mawkanuli, Gina-Anne Levow

entry.title: Towards Orthographically-Informed Evaluation of Speech Recognition Systems for Indian Languages

author.name: Kaushal Santosh Bhogale, Tahir Javed, Greeshma Susan John, Dhruv Rathi, Akshayasree Padmanaban, Niharika Parasa, Mitesh M. Khapra

entry.title: A Study on Building Efficient Zero-Shot Relation Extraction Models

author.name: Hugo Thomas, Caio Corro, Guillaume Gravier, Pascale S\'ebillot

entry.title: Beyond the Resum\'e: A Rubric-Aware Automatic Interview System for Information Elicitation

author.name: Harry Stuart, Masahiro Kaneko, Timothy Baldwin

entry.summary: Proposes an LLM-based automated interview system that elicits rubric-specific information from job candidates, updating beliefs about applicant qualifications through structured dialogue.

entry.title: LLM-as-an-Annotator: Training Lightweight Models with LLM-Annotated Examples for Aspect Sentiment Tuple Prediction

entry.title: Semantic Novelty Trajectories in 80,000 Books: A Cross-Corpus Embedding Analysis

author.name: Fred Zimmerman

entry.title: End-to-End Simultaneous Dysarthric Speech Reconstruction with Frame-Level Adaptor and Multiple Wait-k Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Minghui Wu, Haitao Tang, Jiahuan Fan, Ruizhi Liao, Yanyong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes end-to-end simultaneous dysarthric speech reconstruction with frame-level adaptation and multiple wait-k knowledge distillation, addressing latency issues in streaming scenarios.

entry.title: Power Echoes: Investigating Moderation Biases in Online Power-Asymmetric Conflicts

author.name: Yaqiong Li, Peng Zhang, Peixu Hou, Kainan Tu, Guangping Zhang, Shan Qu, Wenshi Chen, Yan Chen, Ning Gu, Tun Lu

entry.title: DiffSOS: Acoustic Conditional Diffusion Model for Speed-of-Sound Reconstruction in Ultrasound Computed Tomography

author.name: Yujia Wu, Shuoqi Chen, Shiru Wang, Yucheng Tang, Petr Bruza, Geoffrey P. Luke

entry.title: Improved Adversarial Diffusion Compression for Real-World Video Super-Resolution

author.name: Bin Chen, Weiqi Li, Shijie Zhao, Xuanyu Zhang, Junlin Li, Li Zhang, Jian Zhang

entry.summary: Improves adversarial diffusion compression for real-world video super-resolution, adding temporal awareness and enhanced adversarial learning to balance spatial details with temporal consistency.

entry.title: COG: Confidence-aware Optimal Geometric Correspondence for Unsupervised Single-reference Novel Object Pose Estimation

author.name: Yuchen Che, Jingtu Wu, Hao Zheng, Asako Kanezaki

entry.title: RAFM: Retrieval-Augmented Flow Matching for Unpaired CBCT-to-CT Translation

entry.title: Adaptive Dynamic Dehazing via Instruction-Driven and Task-Feedback Closed-Loop Optimization for Diverse Downstream Task Adaptation

author.name: Yafei Zhang, Shuaitian Song, Huafeng Li, Shujuan Wang, Yu Liu

author.name: Cong Wang, Jinshan Pan, Liyan Wang, Wei Wang, Yang Yang

entry.title: Adaptive Augmentation-Aware Latent Learning for Robust LiDAR Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Wangkai Li, Zhaoyang Li, Yuwen Pan, Rui Sun, Yujia Chen, Tianzhu Zhang

author.name: Jiachen Yang, Xianhui Lin, Yi Dong, Zebiao Zheng, Xing Liu, Hong Gu, Yanmei Fang

author.name: Anna Michailidou, Georgios Angelidis, Vasileios Argyriou, Panagiotis Sarigiannidis, Georgios Th. Papadopoulos

entry.title: Align-cDAE: Alzheimer's Disease Progression Modeling with Attention-Aligned Conditional Diffusion Auto-Encoder

author.name: Ayantika Das, Keerthi Ram, Mohanasankar Sivaprakasam

entry.title: A Diffusion-Driven Fine-Grained Nodule Synthesis Framework for Enhanced Lung Nodule Detection from Chest Radiographs

author.name: Aryan Goyal, Shreshtha Singh, Ashish Mittal, Manoj Tadepalli, Piyush Kumar, Preetham Putha

entry.title: Event-Only Drone Trajectory Forecasting with RPM-Modulated Kalman Filtering

entry.title: Multiview Progress Prediction of Robot Activities

entry.title: DAM-VLA: A Dynamic Action Model-Based Vision-Language-Action Framework for Robot Manipulation

author.name: Xiongfeng Peng, Jiaqian Yu, Dingzhe Li, Yixiang Jin, Lu Xu, Yamin Mao, Chao Zhang, Weiming Li, Sujin Jang, Dongwook Lee, Daehyun Ji

entry.title: SFCo-Nav: Efficient Zero-Shot Visual Language Navigation via Collaboration of Slow LLM and Fast Attributed Graph Alignment

author.name: Chaoran Xiong, Litao Wei, Xinhao Hu, Kehui Ma, Ziyi Xia, Zixin Jiang, Zhen Sun, Ling Pei

entry.title: Why Not? Solver-Grounded Certificates for Explainable Mission Planning

entry.title: Nano-EmoX: Unifying Multimodal Emotional Intelligence from Perception to Empathy

author.name: Jiahao Huang, Fengyan Lin, Xuechao Yang, Chen Feng, Kexin Zhu, Xu Yang, Zhide Chen

author.name: Ronald Schnitzer, Maximilian Hoeving, Sonja Zillner

entry.title: Phishing the Phishers with SpecularNet: Hierarchical Graph Autoencoding for Reference-Free Web Phishing Detection

author.name: Tailai Song, Pedro Casas, Michela Meo

entry.summary: Introduces SpecularNet, a lightweight phishing detection framework that operates solely on domain names and raw HTML without external knowledge bases, using hierarchical graph autoencoders for reference-free detection.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware Concept and Motion Segmentation for Semi-Supervised Angiography Videos

author.name: Yu Luo, Guangyu Wei, Yangfan Li, Jieyu He, Yueming Lyu

entry.summary: Introduces a 3D mesh convolution-based autoencoder for geometry compression that works directly on irregular mesh data without preprocessing or manifold conditions.

entry.title: NextAds: Towards Next-generation Personalized Video Advertising

entry.title: Test-Driven Agentic Framework for Reliable Robot Controller

author.name: Shivanshu Tripathi, Reza Akbarian Bafghi, Maziar Raissi

entry.summary: Proposes a test-driven agentic framework that iteratively refines LLM-generated robot controller code using diagnostic feedback from structured test suites, with a dual-tier repair strategy combining prompt-level and code-level refinement.

entry.title: RAG-RUSS: A Retrieval-Augmented Robotic Ultrasound for Autonomous Carotid Examination

author.name: Dianye Huang, Ziping Cong, Nassir Navab, Zhongliang Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces RAG-RUSS, a retrieval-augmented framework for autonomous robotic ultrasound carotid examination that provides interpretable decision-making aligned with clinical workflows.

entry.title: B$^2$F-Map: Crowd-sourced Mapping with Bayesian B-spline Fusion

author.name: Yiping Xie, Yuxuan Xia, Erik Stenborg, Junsheng Fu, Axel Beauvisage, Gabriel E. Garcia, Tianyu Wu, Gustaf Hendeby

entry.title: Optimizing In-Context Demonstrations for LLM-based Automated Grading

author.name: Yucheng Chu, Hang Li, Kaiqi Yang, Yasemin Copur-Gencturk, Kevin Haudek, Joseph Krajcik, Jiliang Tang

entry.title: Information-Theoretic Framework for Self-Adapting Model Predictive Controllers

author.name: Wael Hafez, Amir Nazeri

entry.summary: Introduces Entanglement Learning, an information-theoretic framework enhancing Model Predictive Control adaptability through Information Digital Twin monitoring of information flow between inputs, actions, and behavior.

entry.title: Agentic Multi-Source Grounding for Enhanced Query Intent Understanding: A DoorDash Case Study

author.name: Emmanuel Aboah Boateng, Kyle MacDonald, Akshad Viswanathan, Sudeep Das

entry.summary: Presents an agentic multi-source grounding system for DoorDash that maps ambiguous user queries to multiple business categories using catalog retrieval and web search, emitting ordered multi-intent sets.

entry.title: CeProAgents: A Hierarchical Agents System for Automated Chemical Process Development

author.name: Yuhang Yang, Ruikang Li, Jifei Ma, Kai Zhang, Qi Liu, Jianyu Han, Yonggan Bu, Jibin Zhou, Defu Lian, Xin Li, Enhong Chen

entry.summary: Introduces CeProAgents, a hierarchical multi-agent system for automating chemical process development through collaborative division of labor across knowledge, concept, and parameter agent cohorts with a novel hybrid architecture.

entry.title: OpenRad: a Curated Repository of Open-access AI models for Radiology

author.name: Konstantinos Vrettos, Galini Papadaki, Emmanouil Brilakis, Matthaios Triantafyllou, Dimitrios Leventis, Despina Staraki, Maria Mavroforou, Eleftherios Tzanis, Konstantina Giouroukou, Michail E. Klontzas

entry.title: AI-Generated Letters from the Future: A Randomized Test of Personalized Climate Communication

author.name: Nattavudh Powdthavee, Pat Pataranutaporn, Sandra J. Geiger, Louisa Richter, Mathew P. White

entry.title: LitBench: A Graph-Centric Large Language Model Benchmarking Tool For Literature Tasks

author.name: Andreas Varvarigos, Ali Maatouk, Jiasheng Zhang, Ngoc Bui, Jialin Chen, Leandros Tassiulas, Rex Ying

entry.title: Iterative LLM-based improvement for French Clinical Interview Transcription and Speaker Diarization

author.name: Ambre Marie (LaTIM), Thomas Bertin (DySoLab), Guillaume Dardenne (LaTIM), Gwenol\'e Quellec (LaTIM)

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-pass LLM post-processing architecture for improving French clinical speech transcription by alternating between speaker and word recognition passes, achieving significant improvements on suicide prevention conversations.

entry.title: Exploring Drug Safety Through Knowledge Graphs: Protein Kinase Inhibitors as a Case Study

author.name: David Jackson, Michael Gertz, J\"urgen Hesser

entry.summary: Presents a knowledge graph framework unifying diverse drug safety sources (ChEMBL, PubMed, FAERS) into an evidence-weighted network for protein kinase inhibitors, enabling contextual comparison of efficacy and safety profiles.

entry.title: Pulse-Driven Neural Architecture: Learnable Oscillatory Dynamics for Robust Continuous-Time Sequence Processing

author.name: Paras Sharma

entry.summary: PDNA augments continuous-time recurrent networks with learnable oscillatory dynamics and recurrent self-attention, improving robustness to input gaps in sequential processing tasks.

entry.title: Automated Discovery of Improved Constant Weight Binary Codes

author.name: Christopher D. Rosin

entry.summary: Uses tabu search and a novel greedy heuristic to establish improved lower bounds on constant weight binary codes A(n,d,w) for 24 parameter combinations, discovered by AI-guided search.

entry.title: LiaisonAgent: An Multi-Agent Framework for Autonomous Risk Investigation and Governance

author.name: Chuanming Tang, Ling Qing, Shifeng Chen

entry.title: Physical Evaluation of Naturalistic Adversarial Patches for Camera-Based Traffic-Sign Detection

author.name: Brianna D'Urso, Tahmid Hasan Sakib, Syed Rafay Hasan, Terry N. Guo

entry.title: Quantifying Catastrophic Forgetting in IoT Intrusion Detection Systems

author.name: Sourasekhar Banerjee, David Bergqvist, Salman Toor, Christian Rohner, Andreas Johnsson

entry.title: TMR-VLA:Vision-Language-Action Model for Magnetic Motion Control of Tri-leg Silicone-based Soft Robot

author.name: Ruijie Tang, Chi Kit Ng, Kaixuan Wu, Long Bai, Guankun Wang, Yiming Huang, Yupeng Wang, Hongliang Ren

entry.summary: Proposes Bi-cLSTM, a bidirectional residual-corrected LSTM for aero-engine remaining useful life estimation with condition-aware preprocessing and adaptive residual correction.

entry.title: Intent-Context Synergy Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous UAV Decision-Making in Air Combat

author.name: Jiahao Fu, Feng Yang

entry.summary: Proposes ICS-RL framework for autonomous UAV decision-making in air combat with LSTM-based intent prediction and context-aware reward shaping to balance mission efficiency and survivability.

entry.title: PARWiS: Winner determination under shoestring budgets using active pairwise comparisons

author.name: Shailendra Bhandari

entry.summary: Implements and extends the PARWiS algorithm for winner determination using active pairwise comparisons under limited budgets, adding contextual and RL-based variants.

entry.title: Towards Data-driven Nitrogen Estimation in Wheat Fields using Multispectral Images

author.name: Andreas Tritsarolis, Toma\v{z} Bokan, Matej Brumen, Domen Mongus, Yannis Theodoridis

entry.summary: Presents TerrAI, a neural network solution for targeted spraying and fertilization in agriculture using multispectral imagery, accounting for spatio-temporal variability across parcels.

entry.title: FujiView: Multimodal Late-Fusion for Predicting Scenic Visibility

author.name: Bryceton Bible, Shah Md Nehal Hasnaeen, Hairong Qi

entry.summary: Presents FujiView, a multimodal framework and dataset for predicting Mount Fuji visibility by fusing webcam imagery with weather data. Dataset includes 100K+ images from 40+ cameras.

entry.title: On the Exact Algorithmic Extraction of Finite Tesselations Through Prime Extraction of Minimal Representative Forms

author.name: Sushish Baral, Paulo Garcia, Warisa Sritriratanarak

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical algorithm for exact tessellation extraction in finite planar grids, using composite discovery with dual inspection and breadth-first pruning. Targets symbolic reasoning and structural optimization.

entry.title: SMR-Net:Robot Snap Detection Based on Multi-Scale Features and Self-Attention Network

author.name: Kuanxu Hou

entry.summary: SMR-Net proposes a self-attention based multi-scale object detection network for robot snap detection in automated assembly, using a dedicated sensor for handling transparent or low-contrast components.

entry.title: Autonomous Block Assembly for Boom Cranes with Passive Joint Dynamics: Integrated Vision MPC Control

author.name: Gerald Ebmer, Minh Nhat Vu, Tobias Gl\"uck, Wolfgang Kemmetm\"uller

entry.summary: Presents an autonomous control framework for articulated boom cranes performing block assembly, combining vision-based pose estimation, B-spline path planning, and nonlinear MPC. Validated on a laboratory testbed.

entry.title: Geometric Look-Angle Shaping Strategy for Enclosed Inspection

author.name: Amit Shivam, Manuel C. R. M. Fernandes, Sergio Vinha, Fernando A. C. C. Fontes

entry.summary: Proposes GLASS, a geometric look-angle shaping strategy for UAV inspection of enclosed regions, using hyperbolic tangent shaping within a polar geometric framework with Lyapunov stability guarantees.

entry.title: Agent-Based Simulation of Trust Development in Human-Robot Teams: An Empirically-Validated Framework

author.name: Ravi Kalluri

entry.summary: Presents an agent-based model of trust dynamics in human-robot teams, validated against Hancock et al.'s meta-analysis, finding robot reliability has the strongest effect on trust.

entry.title: Bimanual XR Specification of Relative and Absolute Assembly Hierarchies for Teleoperation

author.name: Benjamin Yang, Xichen He, Charlie Zou, Jen-Shuo Liu, Barbara Tversky, Steven Feiner

entry.title: CLR Summer Research Fellowship 2026

author.name: Tristan Cook

entry.summary: The Center on Long-Term Risk announces its 2026 Summer Research Fellowship, seeking applicants to work on s-risk reduction and empirical AI safety, particularly understanding LLM personas and multi-agent dynamics. The fellowship emphasizes empirical AI safety work more than previous rounds.

entry.title: A Novel Evolutionary Method for Automated Skull-Face Overlay in Computer-Aided Craniofacial Superimposition

author.name: Pr\'axedes Mart\'inez-Moreno, Andrea Valsecchi, Pablo Mesejo, Pilar Navarro-Ram\'irez, Valentino Lugli, Sergio Damas

entry.summary: Lilium is an automated evolutionary method for skull-face overlay in forensic identification, using 3D cone-based soft-tissue representation optimized via Differential Evolution.

entry.title: Multi-Condition Digital Twin Calibration for Axial Piston Pumps : Compound Fault Simulation

author.name: Chang Dong, Jianfeng Tao, Chengliang Liu

entry.title: Reward-Modulated Local Learning in Spiking Encoders: Controlled Benchmarks with STDP and Hybrid Rate Readouts

author.name: Debjyoti Chakraborty

author.name: Nafisha Tamanna Nice

author.name: Rafi Hassan Chowdhury, Naimul Haque, Kaniz Fatiha

entry.title: Trust in Autonomous Human--Robot Collaboration: Effects of Responsive Interaction Policies

author.name: Shauna Heron, Meng Cheng Lau

entry.title: Empirical Study of Gaze Behavior in Children and Young Adults Using Deep Neural Networks and Robot Implementation: A Comparative Analysis of Social Situations

entry.title: High-Resolution Range Profile Classifiers Require Aspect-Angle Awareness

author.name: Edwyn Brient (CMM), Santiago Velasco-Forero (CMM), Rami Kassab

entry.title: Wideband Power Amplifier Behavioral Modeling Using an Amplitude Conditioned LSTM

entry.title: TCG CREST System Description for the DISPLACE-M Challenge

author.name: Nikhil Raghav, Md Sahidullah

author.name: Rui Ma, Yifeng Wang, Ziteng Yang, Xinghui Li

entry.title: A User Study on the Suitability of Teleoperation Interfaces for Primitive Manipulation Tasks

author.name: Jun Aoki, Shunki Itadera

author.name: Kazi Sher Ahmed, Bekir Bediz

entry.title: Smart Prism with Tilt Compensation for CAN bus on Mobile Machinery Using Robotic Total Stations

author.name: Sumesh Sharma, Marcel Moll, Timo Oksanen

entry.title: A Survey Mobility Management in 5G Networks

author.name: A. Nezih Kasim

author.name: Yiquan Gao
